notes.title: Oktoberfest on the Ocean!
notes.notes:
[h2]Grab a sausage and celebrate Oktoberfest![/h2][p]As we see out September, we’re celebrating the next Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Oktoberfest on the Ocean![/b] Running from 18th to 30th September, celebrating the end of the season with a shindig dedicated to pretzels, sausages, chicken dancing and more, with a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/720202839e34853acc958150d577a4c93755ed89.png"][/img][/p][h2]Seasonal Trait: The Brewmaster[/h2][p]The Brewmaster is here, and they're ready to get the party started! When you have a Brewmaster aboard, they'll be asked to set the vibe of the ship during the first day. Whichever vibe they choose will mix up the Paper Pirates voting rules! There are a total of six vibes The Brewmaster can pick for the ship:[/p][list][*][p][b]Aggressive Vibes[/b] - Grants each pirate one additional voting power [/p][/*][*][p][b]Chaotic Vibes[/b] - Instead of voting from Stowaway to Captain, the crew will vote in a randomised order each day[/p][/*][*][p][b]Commanding Vibes[/b] - Voting each day will follow 'Majority Rules', where each pirate has one voting power and the pirate with the most votes goes overboard[/p][/*][*][p][b]Determined Vibes[/b] - Removes the crew's ability to pass their vote[/p][/*][*][p][b]Energetic Vibes[/b] - If nobody has gone overboard after the Captain has voted, a second round of voting begins. Votes from the previous round carry forward[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secretive Vibes - When a pirate casts a vote, the crew will not see who they voted for [/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/99f1a2410f59672aa2f09aac190a735498f58869.png"][/img][/p][p]Every voyage, The Brewmaster will be given a random selection of [b]four [/b]out of the six vibes to choose. Whichever vibe they pick will stay in effect for the rest of the voyage. However, each day The Brewmaster doesn't play in, they can choose to change up the vibe, and bring a new mood to the party. How will having The Brewmaster aboard change the way your crew votes people over? [/p][h2]Grab Limited Time Customisation Options[/h2][p]During Oktoberfest on the Ocean, Sam Sherbot and Nat O’Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Oktoberfest on the Ocean, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/2aa8a9cc5ba6a167ef77b0a762ed00857a36979c.png"][/img][/p][p]The full list of Shop Ship items available during Oktoberfest on the Ocean is: [/p][h3]Outfit Shop[/h3][list][*][p] Face - Animal (Chicken)[/p][/*][*][p] Facial Hair - Imperial[/p][/*][*][p] Shirt - Check Shirt[/p][/*][*][p] Shirt - Animal (Chicken)[/p][/*][*][p] Shirt - Lace Bodice[/p][/*][*][p] Shirt - Dirndl Bodice[/p][/*][*][p] Coat - Hotdog[/p][/*][*][p] Belt - Lederhosen Bracers[/p][/*][*][p] Legs - Animal (Chicken)[/p][/*][*][p] Legs - Lederhosen[/p][/*][*][p] Legs - Dirndl Skirt[/p][/*][*][p] Hands - Animal (Chicken)[/p][/*][*][p] Hands - BBQ Hook[/p][/*][*][p] Hands - Grill Tool[/p][/*][*][p] Hands - Sausage[/p][/*][*][p] Headwear - Hairpin (Sausage)[/p][/*][*][p] Feet - Animal (Chicken)[/p][/*][*][p] Feet - Haferlschuh[/p][/*][*][p] Feet - Sausage[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ship Shop[/h3][list][*][p] Masts - Oktoberfest Tent[/p][/*][*][p] Masts - Skewer I[/p][/*][*][p] Masts - Skewer II[/p][/*][*][p] Masts - Skewer III[/p][/*][*][p] Hulls - Barrel Hull[/p][/*][*][p] Hulls - Sausage[/p][/*][*][p] Sails - Sausages[/p][/*][*][p] Extras - Windmill[/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, during Oktoberfest on the Ocean, pirates can wear the Tyrolean Hat or the Deely Bobber (Pretzel)! They’re available to everyone in voyages started during the event to finish off their Oktoberfest outfits.  Once the event’s over, the hats will disappear from your collection until next year, so be sure to wear them while you can!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/26786b6f51f449364f4301ee5837a7ad36a182f7.png"][/img][/p][h2]The “Biggest Bratwurst” Event![/h2][p]Go on a sailing adventure during Oktoberfest on the Ocean, and any day when there’s a successful job there is a chance you may encounter the “Biggest Bratwurst” event! The pirates stop for a cook-out, each grabbing a sausage from the grill. Some of the sausages are much bigger than the others though, and everyone knows a pirate needs a full stomach to carry out the most important duties on the ship. The bigger your meal, the higher your rank on the ship! So watch out, if you pull a chipolata, you might end up as Stowaway!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ff8d4eac1fae66e68861039450daa6e586b2f2c6.png"][/img][/p][p]The Biggest Bratwurst event is sure to mix things up amongst the crew, changing who’s next to each other and therefore who’s playing in for different groups of jobs together. Not only that, but if you’re playing a trait game, you might want to be extra careful of who ends up next to The Sensitive![/p][h2]Oktoberfest on the Ocean Bots[/h2][p]Invite bots into your game during Oktoberfest on the Ocean, and you may encounter any of four unique bots! Look out for Chicken Bot, Hans Botmann, Ida Botmann and Bot Dog, all of whom are eager to board your ship and throw you overboard! These bots will only join your games during Oktoberfest on the Ocean, so take the chance to meet them now before they chicken dance away for the rest of the year!
[/p]

notes.title: New Trait: The Imitator
notes.notes:
[h3]Joining Paper Pirates today is the new trait, [b]The Imitator[/b]![/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9a1dfb29775cd8c85af5297c5f9af6451acc5f07.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Imitator[/b] is a new passive trait, available in all Trait and Traits+ games. At the start of the voyage, a randomly selected pirate is chosen to be the person that The Imitator is imitating.[/p][p]While they are imitating another pirate, whenever The Imitator's team is revealed - either through traits or events - it will actually reveal the team of the pirate they are imitating.[/p][p]The Imitator knows the identity of the pirate they are imitating, but crucially, they do not know which team they are on until it is revealed through a trait or an event. This means that The Imitator has no way of knowing whether they're going to show up as a human or a ghost when their team is checked.[/p][p]How will they work with the person they're imitating? Will they betray them with truths, betray them with lies, or form an honest pact to work together?[/p][p]The Imitator is one of seven new traits coming to Paper Pirates! More new traits will become available on the following schedule:[/p][list][*][p]1st October 2025[/p][/*][*][p]17th October 2025[/p][/*][*][p]31st October 2025[/p][/*][/list][p]The next trait to be revealed is happening on a very particular date, which might give you a clue...[/p]

notes.title: New Trait: The Dutiful
notes.notes:
[h3]Joining Paper Pirates today is the new trait, [b]The Dutiful[/b]![/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/596a4d31a64fce620e2ed3bf4707f10354921884.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Dutiful[/b] is a new active trait, available in all Trait and Traits+ games with at least six pirates. When The Dutiful doesn't play in, they can activate their trait, controlling which event shows up for that day. When they activate their trait, the day's event will always be the Crew's Duty event for whatever rank The Dutiful is at the time of the event.[/p][p]That means that their power allows them to force the following events:[/p][list][*][p][b]Quartermaster[/b]: Demotion[/p][/*][*][p][b]Navigator[/b]: Plot a Course[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gunner[/b]: Conspiracy[/p][/*][*][p][b]Surgeon[/b]: Botch Job[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shipwright[/b]: Busywork[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cooper[/b]: In the Barrel[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cook[/b]: Suspicious Soup[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cabin Boy[/b]: Captain's Favourite[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stowaway[/b]: Overpower [/p][/*][/list][p]After they've chosen to do this, The Dutiful will need to rest, and won't be able to use their trait for a minimum of three days. When the cooldown has expired, they'll be able to do it again, and there's no limit on the number of times they choose to activate their trait outside of the three day cooldown.[/p][p]The Dutiful might have a plan for an event they want to trigger, but they also need to be careful - if their rank changes before the event triggers, maybe through a sneaky Brawler, they'll get the event for their new rank instead...[/p][p]The Dutiful is one of seven new traits coming to Paper Pirates! More new traits will become available on the following schedule:[/p][list][*][p]19th September 2025[/p][/*][*][p]1st October 2025[/p][/*][*][p]17th October 2025[/p][/*][*][p]31st October 2025[/p][/*][/list][p]You might get a clue to the next trait to be revealed if you look closely in the mirror...[/p]

notes.title: New Trait: The Soothsayer
notes.notes:
[h3]Joining Paper Pirates today is the new trait, [b]The Soothsayer[/b]![/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/68fe54333b82b68cbef31d657730a6afb19ddead.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Soothsayer[/b] is a new passive trait, available in all Trait and Traits+ games with at least seven pirates. The Soothsayer has the power of divination, and their trait comes in handy when they've just been voted overboard - as long as they're on the human team, that is.[/p][p]We all know that when a human pirate is voted overboard, one of the pirates that voted for them will be chosen for a possession. When they're voted overboard, however, The Soothsayer knows exactly which pirate that is. They'll get a pop-up, and a message in their black spot, telling them which pirate was chosen to become a ghost when they were voted overboard.[/p][p]What The Soothsayer chooses to do with that information is, of course, up to them. They might use it to get out of stowaway - though think before you act, how do you know that person really is who they say they are?[/p][p]The Soothsayer is one of seven new traits coming to Paper Pirates! More new traits will become available on the following schedule:[/p][list][*][p]5th September 2025[/p][/*][*][p]19th September 2025[/p][/*][*][p]1st October 2025[/p][/*][*][p]17th October 2025[/p][/*][*][p]31st October 2025[/p][/*][/list][p]The next trait to be revealed is ready and willing to help you with all your daily tasks...[/p]

notes.title: New Trait: The Shapesister
notes.notes: [h3]Joining Paper Pirates today is the new trait, [b]The Shapesister[/b]![/h3][h3] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/d5b0ed67b0228de924437277108ebd7eb2d451b9.png"][/img][/h3][p][b]The Shapesister[/b] is a new passive trait, available in Traits+ games with at least six pirates. This is a partner trait, and interacts directly with whichever pirate on the crew is The Shapeshifter.[/p][p]Whenever The Shapeshifter activates their trait during a job, The Shapesister's team will also be flipped. In the same way as The Shapeshifter, that means if they are a human they will become a ghost, and vice-versa.[/p][p]Neither the Shapesister nor the Shapeshifter know the identity of their partner, though through some sneaky deduction you might be able to figure out who they are and work with them - or against them - for the glory of whichever team you happen to be on.[/p][p]The Shapesister is one of seven new traits coming to Paper Pirates! More new traits will become available on the following schedule:[/p][list][*][p]22nd August 2025[/p][/*][*][p]5th September 2025[/p][/*][*][p]19th September 2025[/p][/*][*][p]1st October 2025[/p][/*][*][p]17th October 2025[/p][/*][*][p]31st October 2025[/p][/*][/list][p]The next trait to be revealed has been foretold in the way the birds are flying...[/p]

notes.title: The Pirate Pool Party!
notes.notes:
[h1]Make a splash with The Pirate Pool Party![/h1][p]Across June and July, we’re celebrating with the wettest Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, The Pirate Pool Party! Running from 24th June to 22nd July, celebrate the warmer weather with a party dedicated to all things poolside, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/bae8618a98018cd1d2b2a1e960375a7a85c43ca2.png"][/img][/p][h2]Seasonal Traits: The Shark & The Bait[/h2][p]The Shark and The Bait appear as a pair, and one is hunting the other! In any game where The Shark and The Bait appear, The Shark has a unique victory condition. If they're able to get The Bait thrown overboard three times - through events and/or voting - they will automatically and instantly achieve a solo victory! Both The Shark and The Bait are passive traits.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f04eec05c857136c63fe4cfa8c5bbd8c3a467ea9.png"][/img]Is someone behaving suspiciously? A bit too keen to throw someone overboard? Maybe they're The Shark! Is someone claiming to be The Bait? Maybe they just don't want to go overboard and really hey're The Cursed? Hmm, tricky times ahead crew...  [/p][p]To make things even more challenging for the crew, The Bait will always appear as a ghost when their team is revealed through traits and events. Be vigilant crew![/p][h2]Party Favours for all the Guests![/h2][p]Any good party comes with goodies to take home, and Pirate Pool Party is no exception! Play Paper Pirates during the Pirate Pool Party and you'll get a special bounty task each day. Complete the task to open a special party favour, which contains some unique outfit customisation options you can't obtain anywhere else!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/0d50286c52701ee3641c8e638fbc337397f46392.png"][/img]There's three outfits, for a combined total of fifteen items, to collect through The Pirate Pool Party. notes.title: New Trait: The Quester
notes.notes:
[h3]Joining Paper Pirates today is the new trait, [b]The Quester[/b]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a641f7cf685d4b31ec2b64b66b128085cb65998f.png[/img]

The Quester is a new passive trait, available in all Trait and Traits+ games. At the start of the voyage, The Quester is given a secret quest to complete. That might be to obey or disobey a number of jobs, change their team, or even go overboard. Only they'll know their secret quest, and whether they choose to try to complete it or not is entirely up to them.

If they are able to complete it, the rewards are sure to be glorious. During the next pre-event phase after they complete their quest, they'll be given a choice of three unique Quester reward events. These include opportunities to swap their rank with another pirate on the ship, exorcise another pirate, or check the team of another pirate, amongst others.

Once The Quester completes their quest and chooses a reward, they'll be given another randomly selected quest to try to complete. There's no limit to how many quests they can complete in one voyage, but they won't get a new one until the old one's finished!

If you find someone is behaving a little oddly, perhaps they're trying to complete their quest to get a special reward!

notes.title: New Trait: The Informant
notes.notes:
[h3]Joining Paper Pirates today is the new trait, [b]The Informant[/b]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fffe5ca2fbc20728afaf138a9abd5ddc99d65ce2.png[/img]

The Informant is a new passive trait, available in all Trait and Traits+ games. At the start of the voyage, The Informant is notified of up to three traits that aren't currently in the voyage. They might be active traits, they might be passive traits, but they'll know for sure that no pirate started the game with that trait.

What will they do with this information? Will they share with the crew which traits they know no pirate has, or is it better to keep quiet and wait to see if you can catch someone out in a lie? Even better, might a sneaky Informant choose to use their information to pretend to be another powerful trait, with full knowledge that nobody will counter-claim them?

notes.title: New Trait: The Robot
notes.notes:
[h3]Joining Paper Pirates today is the new trait, [b]The Robot[/b]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/43cbc33069c2866f44d61663af2f1d61b4932302.png[/img]

Beep boop to all and ghosts! The Robot is a new active trait, available in all Traits+ games. The Robot is our first dual-trait, in that it occupies both the active and passive slot. If you're chosen to be The Robot at the start of the voyage, your passive trait will be automatically set to [b]Deactivated[/b].

On days when The Robot does not play in, they may activate one of their four special modes, replacing Deactivated as their passive trait. The four modes The Robot can activate are:

[list]
[*] [b]Psychic Mode[/b]: Whenever a pirate goes overboard, you can check whether they were a human or a ghost.
[*] [b]Silent Mode[/b]: Whenever The Robot casts a vote at the end of the day, it will show as if they passed. If their vote throws a pirate overboard, voting will still end as usual.
[*] [b]Assassin Mode[/b]: The Robot will always vote first during voting, unless the voyage features The Assassin, when they will instead vote second.
[*] [b]Disguised Mode[/b]: Whenever a pirate checks The Robot's team through an event or trait, The Robot's team will show as the opposite of their true team (e.g., a human Robot will show as a ghost). 
[/list]
The Robot's mode will remain the same until they choose to change it, which they can do so freely any time they don't play in.

The Robot's power to emulate other passive traits makes it very unique. There's bound to be some super sneaky tactics by switching in and out of particular traits at a whim!

notes.title: Spring Sailing!
notes.notes:
[h2]Go Egg Hunting on the Seven Seas with Spring Sailing![/h2]
Across March and April, we’re celebrating with the Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Spring Sailing![/b] Running from 15th March - 12th April, celebrate the season of spring with a festival of eggs, bunnies, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7bc993124ffd3af4fe1d9aa6b2a729c3f5e8c0b8.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Spring Chicken[/h2]
Joining Paper Pirates for the duration of Spring Sailing is the seasonal trait, The Spring Chicken! Play a trait game, and one of the crew may find themselves with this happy-go-lucky, seasonal appropriate trait.

Each day, when The Spring Chicken is not the Captain, they will spring forward one rank of the crew at the start of the event phase! This happens even if there's no other event taking place! What seems like a blessing may be a curse - watch out if you're a ghostly Spring Chicken and you're almost next to The Sensitive...

[h2]The Grand Spring Egg Hunt[/h2]
Every day during Spring Sailing the crew will be challenged to an Egg Hunt by our very own Rabbot! They've hidden a number of eggs all throughout Paper Pirates for you to find - they could be in any of the menu screens, or even in-game! Find your quota each day, and you'll be able to open a special Spring Sailing surprise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/91584d0620807cba8863b805ef7665362fccbdd0.png[/img]

There's three outfits for a combined total of [b]sixteen[/b] items, to collect through The Grand Spring Egg Hunt. Make sure to check for eggs every day, and get ready to dress up!

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]
During Spring Sailing, Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Spring Sailing, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today!

notes.title: New Trait: The Unfortunate
notes.notes:
[h3]Joining Paper Pirates today is the new trait, [b]The Unfortunate[/b]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/1616daa42856210529e50cf43ae201c674b3429e.png[/img]

The Unfortunate is a passive trait, available in all Trait and Traits+ games. When The Unfortunate chooses to vote, they're really taking their future into their hands. Should they participate in a vote to throw a human overboard, they will [b]always[/b] be the pirate chosen to become a ghost no matter who else voted, how many votes they cast, or which team they're on.

This doesn't impact any events, so for example, The Unfortunate wouldn't be guaranteed to become a ghost should they choose to throw a human Captain overboard during a Mutiny event. Only votes cast at the end of the day will trigger The Unfortunate's unfortunate ability.

Despite the name, The Unfortunate might be able to use their power to their advantage. If they vote someone overboard, and don't become a ghost, they know that pirate must have been on the ghost team... but how will they convince the crew to believe them?

notes.title: Big Birthday Bash!
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy birthday, Paper Pirates![/h1]
It's Paper Pirates' fifth birthday, and we’re celebrating with the return of The Big Birthday Bash! Running from 28th February - 14th March, celebrate the anniversary of the game's launch with a festival of partying, and a whole host of anniversary goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a0ec834d9ccdd49ae685e176d527a1a133bbf7d2.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Magician[/h2]
Joining Paper Pirates for the duration of The Big Birthday Bash is the seasonal passive trait, The Magician! Play a Trait or Traits+ game during The Big Birthday Bash, and one of the crew may find themselves playing as The Magician.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a9061627fa02d98b144147b96d32307494593ccf.png[/img]

When the entire crew have finished voting, but no pirate has gone overboard, The Magician will have the opportunity to cast a [b]magic vote[/b]. This magic vote has [b]three[/b] voting power, and can be cast for any pirate (other than The Magician themselves). The crew won't know who The Magician is, unless they can figure it out through deductive reasoning!

The magic vote still counts as voting for a pirate to go overboard, so if The Magician throws a human overboard they run the risk of becoming a ghost. Question is... who are they?

[h2]The “Let Them Eat Cake” Event![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during The Big Birthday Bash, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the “Let Them Eat Cake” event. The crew will divide up a huge birthday cake, taking the chance to blow out the candles one by one. It's believed that the last person who blows out a candle will get to make a wish... what will they wish for, and will their wish come true?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/70386c31bd463a3527c88c36361f472849847835.png[/img]

Every day during The Big Birthday Bash the crew will receive a special birthday gift bounty! If you complete the assigned task, you can open a present, and inside you will find... a special cosmetic surprise! There are [b]sixteen[/b] different cosmetics in total to collect, so make sure to collect your birthday gifts during the seasonal celebration!

notes.title: An Elaborate History of Chess Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
Ahoy Chess fans!

We're really pleased to share that the next game from Iteration Games, An Elaborate History of Chess, now has a a playable demo on Steam as part of this month's Next Fest!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3475690/An_Elaborate_History_of_Chess_Demo/

The demo gives you the opportunity to explore the real-time strategy overworld, farming turnips, fighting rats, building castles, and promoting your pieces. Progress far enough in the overworld, and you'll have the chance to experience one of the turn-based dungeons, featuring combat, puzzles, loot, and intrigue.

As an added bonus, there is a special bounty available in Paper Pirates until 31st March 2025. If you have the An Elaborate History of Chess demo added to your Steam library and installed, this bounty will complete and unlock a special crossover outfit for you to use. We don't want to spoil it, but we think it's pretty fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e0050abfa650f19e990cbe42ffa0bba58b787213.png[/img]
If you play the demo, it would really help if you could consider leaving us a review on the demo's store page. Reviews really help with visibility, and will hopefully allow more people to discover both An Elaborate History of Chess and Paper Pirates. If you haven't already, we'd love it if you gave An Elaborate History of Chess a quick wishlist too, so you can find out when the game launches.

notes.title: New Trait: The Prosecutor
notes.notes:
[h3]Joining Paper Pirates today is the new trait, [b]The Prosecutor[/b]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/86133363635f89522a4924dd958716ffc6e8f080.png[/img]

The Prosecutor is an active trait, available in Trait and Traits+ games with at least seven pirates. On days when The Prosecutor doesn't play in, they may attempt to conduct an exorcism on any other pirate.

If the pirate they choose is on the ghost team, then that pirate will be publicly exorcised for all to see. Hooray, a new human is on the ship!

If, however, the pirate they choose is on the human team, then things will look bleak for The Prosecutor. They will immediately be thrown overboard (in an overboarding that does not create a ghost), and they will lose their prosecutor power for the remainder of the voyage.

How confident will The Prosecutor feel? What opportunities are there for bluffing and second-guessing? The Prosecutor can appear with any passive trait, including The Tainted. Is the ultimate way to make it look like you're on the human team betraying all your fellow ghosts?

[h1]Find romance on the seven seas with Valentine Voyages![/h1]
This February, we’re again celebrating with the Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, Valentine Voyages! Running from[b] 7th February - 21st February[/b], celebrate the season of love with a festival of romance, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ec21a7cdbae881e6c4dfc62828c47e74dbf7d57b.png[/img]
Voyages blessed by a mysterious benefactor will have one extra special secret. Every day when a job fails, the mysterious benefactor will send a secret note to a random pirate. That note will expose some information about the crew's traits! They might share a trait that nobody on the crew currently has, or, tell you the trait someone on the crew has.

With a mysterious benefactor sharing all the crew's darkest secrets, how can you bluff your way out of an unexpected surprise reveal?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/1f1c39e48a18d9b0773177dafea2b30506de1490.png[/img]
The Lovers always appear as a pair, with two randomly chosen pirates from the crew both having the trait 'The Lovers'. When either pirate with The Lovers trait goes overboard, the other pirate will become Heartbroken, automatically going overboard the following day after the job completes. If a heartbroken pirate happens to go overboard before the end of the next day's job, they won't go overboard twice!

Be warned - if a pirates goes overboard due to heartbreak and they're a human, one randomly selected other pirate will become a ghost. Now that's spooky!

The Admirer's team will no longer change through other means (if they're a human, they can't join the ghost team unless their target pirate is haunted), so watch out for any very tricky Admirer plays!

notes.title: Soggy Hogmanay!
notes.notes:
Throughout January, we’re celebrating with the Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Soggy Hogmanay[/b]! Running from 1st January - 21st January, celebrate the start of the New Year with a festival of glad tidings, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ae63053a43fe6452a0bbbe678f4825f4d5e7cdff.png[/img]
[h2]The Crew's Resolution[/h2]
New for 2025, all voyages during Soggy Hogmanay will start with a brand new day one event: The Crew's Resolution. When presented with The Crew's Resolution, each crew member will have to vote on one of a small selection of vows that they want the whole crew to commit to for the remainder of the voyage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6374b23c34f22a649cf121bb1c03880f532aff21.png[/img]
Whichever vow receives the most votes will immediately come into effect for the whole crew. Each vow will dramatically change the way voting works, which means this is a high stakes choice. There are six different vows, and whichever vow is chosen for your voyage is bound to make a difference. 

[h2]Seasonal Event: [b]Change of Resolution[/b][/h2]
Are things not going to plan? Do you regret the decisions you made at the very start of the voyage? What you need is a Change of Resolution event! When this happens, the entire crew will be offered the opportunity to change the vow they picked at the start of the voyage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fb7b1d7186cc72e4b4cc43b0842e09997384acf5.png[/img]
Who knows what has happened since day one? Maybe now you feel quite differently about how your crewmates are using their newfound voting powers? However you feel, it's all change with a Change of Resolution!

[h2]Seasonal Trait: [b]The Resolute[/b][/h2]
Returning to Soggy Hogmanay is the seasonal trait, The Resolute! Play a trait game during Soggy Hogmanay, and one of the crew may find themselves playing as The Resolute.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fdaf53c3d4ac756366c182f624ab5e41dde8d751.png[/img]
The Resolute must make a New Year's Resolution during the first day of the voyage. Their resolution asks them to pledge their allegiance to either the human or the ghost team. Whichever team they pick, they will instantly join - and they won't be able to become a member of the opposite team for the entirety of the remainder of the voyage!

Their choice is private to them, so make sure you don't get caught out by a sneaky Resolute pretending to have become a perma-human, when they might actually have just become The Tainted's best friend...

[h2]Seasonal Trait Event: [b]The Resolute's Resolve[/b][/h2]
New for 2025, The Resolute has a special seasonal Trait Event! If they're lucky enough for the crew to encounter a The Resolute's Resolve event during the voyage, The Resolute will have the opportunity to change their mind about the resolution they made at the start of the voyage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f7bc342d244fbd278b1125534c9f2e73091ae915.png[/img]
This means that a resolute who originally decided to become a permanent ghost could change to become a permanent human, or vice versa. Thought you had The Resolute all figured out? Watch out, as they could change right before your eyes!

[h2]Seasonal Event: [b]The Fastest First Foot[/b][/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Soggy Hogmanay, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the ‘Fastest First Foot’ event, inspired by the Hogmanay tradition of First Footing. As the crew return from an adventure on a deserted treasure island, they race to see who has the honour of first footing the pirate ship. Those pirates who make it back first are granted good fortune for the coming voyage - and will be given a higher rank on the ship accordingly! Have your devices at the ready and press a button as soon as it appears, and any pirate has the chance of seizing the rank of captain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/0d8256140440003a8e0f1d1573638dd749c87c30.png[/img]

Rumour has spread of a mysterious monster at sea... what could it be? Is it even real? During Soggy Hogmanay, if you scour the seven seas enough, you might catch a glimpse of a very special creature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c04c4ec233441e16bcf3d5a8a6b2b05fee0bddfa.png[/img]
Check your bounty board after every voyage, because your time spent at sea might unveil a very special reward for you and your crew. You only have until the end of Soggy Hogmanay to complete the bounty, so make sure you make a new year's resolution to spend more time sailing than ever before!

notes.title: Yule Tides!
notes.notes:
[h2]Prepare for Merriment and Mischief on the Yule Tides![/h2]
Throughout all of December, we’re celebrating, sharing, and gift giving, with Yule Tides! Running from 1st December - 31st December, celebrate Christmas with a festival of merriment and joy, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ce7d805bff1f386e8111f2c09c94c1b41d822635.png[/img]
[h2]Seasonal Trait+: The Miser[/h2]
The Miser is a new seasonal trait for 2024, appearing only in Trait+ games. The Miser has the ability to block a pirate from appearing in any jobs. That's right - once The Miser has targeted a pirate, the Captain will never be offered a job with that pirate in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/36eb2c5d39ab7dceb0d0f5bbe89cdde503fdb17c.png[/img]

This can give you a tactical advantage not only by excluding pirates from playing in because you think they might disobey (or even obey), but you can also ensure that a pirate has the opportunity to use their Active Trait.

The Miser must choose a pirate to exclude from jobs during day one, and then may change their mind about which pirate they're blocking on any day when they do not play in. Because The Captain always plays in, The Miser's powers will not be able to stop The Captain!

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Gift Giver[/h2]
The special seasonal trait for Yule Tides is [b]The Gift Giver[/b]! Play a trait game during Yule Tides and one of the pirates may find themselves playing as The Gift Giver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7929060f5af8c6cb0856a185b84d06130c95533e.png[/img]

The Gift Giver is offered a present to gift to a pirate of their choice on every day when they don't play in. There are a range of different gifts, but which one you get to give is random each day! You can only give three gifts on each voyage - and to make things even more tricky, each pirate can only receive a gift once.

Will you get the gifts you need to sail to success? Or will you accidentally end up giving away a victory to the ghosts.

[h2]Advent Bounties[/h2]
During the Christmas season, the bounty board is celebrating each and every day that passes! Each day throughout December, you’ll receive a special Advent Bounty, with a challenge for you to complete! If you complete an advent bounty, you'll be rewarded with a special Paper Pirates Present! There are [b]eleven[/b] items for you to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9157c2f873325f7c5cc3a45c5361bab923c99bc6.png[/img]

The advent bounties are time-limited, so you have to complete them on the day you get them - but don’t worry if you don’t, there’ll be a new one waiting for you tomorrow!

[h2]A Special Christmas Present[/h2]
Returning from last year, there's a special Christmas bounty, available to every good pirate! All you need to do to complete it is have [b]five[/b] Snowball Fights during Yule Tides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f49583193c64dc844cf7e220025b20e43957f134.png[/img]

Completing the bounty will unlock a special outfit reward for all pirates to use permanently. If you completed the bounty last year, this year you'll get a bumper crop of coins to spend!

Once the event’s over, the hats will disappear from your collection until next year, so be sure to wear them while you can!

[h2]Seasonal Event: Cracking Crackers[/h2]
While sailing on the even seas during Yule Tides, you might find the crew getting a little rowdy with all the partying and merriment! Encounter the Cracking Crackers event, and two members of your crew will decide to pull a giant size festive cracker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9bdae9e3c239ee0e1156d6724abbd3f1df7400eb.png[/img]

Hit the button on your device more times than your opponent to claim the bigger half of the cracker - and save yourself from certain doom, as the loser will be flung overboard from the force of the cracker's explosion! Watch out though, if the losing pirate was a human, the one walking away with the bigger piece will now be a ghost...

[h2]Seasonal Event: Snowball Fight![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Yule Tides, and each day there is a chance it may begin to snow giving the crew the opportunity to partake in a little festive fun - a traditional snowball fight! When Snowball Fight is triggered, each member of the crew must choose who to pelt with a snowball. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/24388077cf067ade639f06b6876e6bbec1727222.png[/img]

The pirate who receives the most snowballs will be thrown overboard! Who will you throw your snowball at? When they go overboard, if they’re a human, one of the people who threw the snowball will become a ghost… so choose wisely!

[h2]Seasonal Event: Naughty or Nice?[/h2]
During your Yule Tides sailing adventures, you may encounter the ‘Naughty or Nice’ event during the event phase of the game. In ‘Naughty or Nice’, one member of the crew must offer a gift to another. Question is - has the receiver been naughty, or nice? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a791b387abde0a64441d7f63daa58776158a55af.png[/img]

The present-giver must decide, with a host of fun positive outcomes for nice, and some meaner tricks for naughty. When the receiver is given the gift, they can choose whether to open it, or discard it. Do you think your crewmate has sent you something nice, or are they a ghost, hoping to catch you out? That’s all part of festive deception!

[h2]Yule Tidings come to the Photo Booth[/h2]
To celebrate the season, there are a small number of limited-time Foils and Backgrounds available in the Photo Booth, in the Captain’s Log. Take the opportunity to snap your favourite pirate templates with a little festive frivolity, and don’t forget to share any pics you take! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/98e048142b81c885db30524f3a4cd52800cb4c3b.png[/img]

[h2]Yule Tides Bots[/h2]
Invite some bots into your game during Yule Tides, and you may find some of the regular crew replaced with some particularly festive bots, out to celebrate Christmas! They’ll only join your games during Yule Tides, but each has their own personality and appearance for you to enjoy.

notes.title: The Festive Feast!
notes.notes:
[h2]What are you thankful for during the Festive Feast Event?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/486b22700b2487a0e95890a90c2acf3fe46c2721.png[/img]
Through the second half of November, we’re taking some time to be thankful in our most delicious seasonal event, The Festive Feast! Running from 16th November - 30th November, celebrate the harvest season with a festival of feasting and thankfulness and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Chef[/h2]
A new seasonal trait for Festive Feast 2024 is [b]The Chef[/b]! The Chef is an active trait, appearing only in Trait+ games, which embodies the spirit of the Festive Feast. On day one, The Chef may pick any other pirate to share a meal with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/070b1208fa77f19f1d6eb1e3d66e6613a2fa793f.png[/img]
While The Chef is sharing a meal with another pirate, that pirate may use their active trait without spending any resources. This means that The Witch can brew potions without using up ingredients, The Reaper can enact pacts without spending souls, and any charge-based traits get unlimited uses.

The Chef doesn't restore used resources, so if you know The Chef is aboard you might want to be a bit more careful about which resources you spend and when.

How will The Chef help, or hinder, the crew?

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Quarterback[/h2]
Our seasonal trait for The Festive Feast is [b]The Quarterback[/b]! The Quarterback is gifted with an exploding football, and knows exactly how many days the football will take to explode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5590d9f073908136bbc1b337f5ceac6074a2a4e6.png[/img]
They may pass the ball to any other pirate, who then has the chance to either pass it on to another pirate or keep hold of it in the pre-event phase of the next day. The Quarterback will always know exactly how many days there are until the football explodes, throwing the pirate currently holding it overboard. Can you trust The Quarterback's timings, or will you find yourself blown up by their lies?

[h2]Make a Wish Every Day[/h2]
Play Paper Pirates during The Festive Feast and you can make a festive wish once per day! Play at least one game, and after your voyage you'll receive a gift from the bounty board!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b58b98a0ba216c90b460848e704d94a91e1d0b70.png[/img]
There are five American football-themed outfit pieces for you to collect from the daily quests, so make sure to play a game of Paper Pirates on five different days before the celebration ends on the 30th November!

[h2]Special Harvest Bounty[/h2]
Last year, we introduced a special [b]harvest[/b] bounty with a super special reward for playing [b]five[/b] games, of any mode, during the Festive Feast. If you missed your chance to complete the bounty last year, you have another chance to complete it this year to earn your super special reward!

If you did complete the bounty last year, you'll have another chance to complete it for a bumper bounty of coins - useful for visiting the Shop Ship and buying all the goodies you want!

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/aa9aa07e451e82891bc9ab0cf98de2afd09589c1.png[/img]

notes.title: The Swapful Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New traits and new events galore![/h1]
In this Paper Pirates update, we're adding seven new traits, including one exclusive to games that make use of the Crew's Choice event selection method, and five new events to help ensure that every voyage is completely unique.

[h2]New Trait: The Acrobats[/h2]
The Acrobats is a new active trait for both Trait and Trait+ games. The Acrobats appear as a pair, and on a day when either of The Acrobats doesn't play in, they can choose to trade their rank on the ship with each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/92e42d7663f9e6c00ea6383340b40aa227595921.png[/img]
There's no limit to the amount of times The Acrobats can activate their trait, so they can continue swapping back and forth as long as they're not in a job. How will the power struggle of The Acrobats change the team dynamics on the ship?

[h2]New Trait: The Watcher[/h2]
The Watcher is a new active trait for both Trait and Trait+ games. On Day One, The Watcher may choose any other pirate from the crew. Any time that pirate plays in, The Watcher will be informed whether they chose to obey or disobey the job.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b28ad3a447f722d962a30021a9e9e609335f9a25.png[/img]
When The Watcher doesn't play in, they may choose to change which pirate they're watching. Like The Protector, they may choose to watch a different pirate as many times as they choose. They can even watch the captain!

[h2]New Trait: The Clairvoyant[/h2]
The Clairvoyant is a new active trait for both Trait and Trait+ games. On days when The Clairvoyant does not play in, they may activate their trait to privately and secretly check how many pirates are currently on the ghost team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b7a8de7b21563a50e7b3f56f19c960e656abeba5.png[/img]
They may only use this power three times per voyage, so choosing when to check could provide pivotal strategic information. For example, you could check before and after an overboarding to see whether the number of ghosts goes down or up.

[h2]New Trait: The Influencer[/h2]
The Influencer is a new passive trait for Trait and Trait+ games using the Crew's Choice event selection method. Customise a game to change the event selection method to Crew's Choice, and every day when an event occurs, each crew member can use the Compass of Fate to vote on which event they'd like to see happen. It's not majority rules, so even a single vote could be enough to doom the crew!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8489d3f9bb4fa6a07812fb02d56cb0dd0dbd8ddc.png[/img]
The Influencer has more power over the Compass of Fate, and every time they vote for an event, it will be three times more likely to be chosen. Will they use this influence for good, or for evil?

[h2]New Trait: The Vindicator[/h2]
The Vindicator is a new passive trait for Trait and Trait+ games. Be wary of any voyage with The Vindicator, as they have quite a nasty power that's automatically activated any time they're voted overboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fb845902a58469c904008f1038888ad815297e6d.png[/img]
When The Vindicator is voted overboard, they'll place a curse on the pirates that voted for them. At the start of each subsequent voting round, The Vindicator will automatically place a number of votes on each pirate that doomed them - and these votes will continue to appear every day until a pirate is next voted overboard. Be careful when voting!

[h2]New Trait: The Resilient[/h2]
The Resilient is a new passive trait for Trait and Trait+ games. The Resilient is harder to throw over than other pirates, and requires three votes above the current threshold as a minimum to be thrown overboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/57cf305a67ecd4a13794f0f30d666dde446bcc36.png[/img]
[h2]New Trait: The Fickle[/h2]
The Fickle is a new active trait for Trait+ games. On days when The Fickle does not play in, they may activate their treat to privately and secretly exchange their current passive trait for another trait that no other pirate currently has.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/bfd03788080208b01bf73c6c303a14c55a9def59.png[/img]
They may only use this power three times per voyage, so they can't just change endlessly, but a pirate who's The Fickle could be The Tainted one minute and The Pure the next. Even worse, a pirate could just be pretending to be The Fickle - now that's a power play!

[h2]Updated Trait: The Gardener[/h2]
The Gardener has gained access to a whole new plant! Spend three days growing some Deadly Nightshades to decorate the ship, and they'll make it so that events which mostly end with a pirate going overboard will be much more likely to occur. Very dangerous!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fb02eea52afd2f7033096d3230bbbb1d1bd7997d.png[/img]
[h2]New Event: Shifting Seasons[/h2]
Shifting Seasons is a new event that appears in all game modes. When a Shifting Seasons event occurs, the crew will be able to vote on a seasonal change that will have a temporary significant impact on gameplay. The crew can choose whether they want to experience Longer Days or Longer Nights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8e939cd151d134288238fa71a628678db9da092c.png[/img]
When the Longer Days effect is in play, there are two chances for events to occur each day. There's nothing stopping the same event from happening twice in a row, so you could even have a double Exorcism - or a double Possession! The events drawn in the bonus slot come from a selection of key events, so you won't end up with two Island Adventures in one day. Longer Days lasts for two days from when Shifting Seasons occurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ee034ef62748b15369bc8557108ff85bdf2bdae4.png[/img]
When the Longer Nights effect is in play, all pirates will have a second chance to cast a vote during voting provided no pirate has gone overboard yet. Every vote counts when another pirate might use that vote to throw someone overboard! Longer Nights lasts for three voting rounds from when Shifting Seasons occurs.

[h2]New Event: Free For All[/h2]
Free For All is a new event that appears only in Trait+ games. When a Free For All happens, an ongoing effect will trigger that allows all pirates to use their active traits without spending any resources. This means that active traits with charges will get one free use, The Witch can brew a potion without using any of their resources, The Reaper could enact a pact without spending souls, and many more possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/2fdfb4b93bec5a6a255c2ed2d866859297254a2f.png[/img]
The effect only lasts for one day, so be careful who you choose to put in the job when Free For All is in effect. It also doesn't renew any of your resources, so if you've already used up all of your charges or spent all of your ingredients - you still won't be able to activate your ability. Maybe it's always worth saving a charge for the end of the voyage?

[h2]New Event: Swapportunity[/h2]
Swapportunity is a new event that appears only in Trait+ games. When a Swapportunity happens, all pirates will have the option to choose whether they want to swap their passive trait with another pirate on the ship, or keep the passive trait they currently have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e78452b9a6df327442179443b9ef196cf42f697f.png[/img]
If at least two pirates opt into the Swapportunity, then two pirates will be randomly selected to permanently exchange their passive traits. It's like The Traders, but for anyone, and only once!

[h2]New Event: Freakier Friday[/h2]
Freaky Friday is a really popular event, and we've somehow made it even freakier! Freakier Friday is an event appearing in all game modes, which picks three pirates at random and shuffles their teams completely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7621bd3a08219e242676e98814e5281683d3508b.png[/img]
You'll know which three pirates were picked for the exchange, but you won't know whose team has gone to who, so there's lots of mystery to figure out!

[h2]New Trait Event: The Shapeshifter's Switch[/h2]
The Shapeshifter's Switch is a new Trait event which can occur only when one of the crew is The Shapeshifter. When The Shapeshifter's Switch occurs, The Shapeshifter can choose any other pirate and flip their team. That means if they're a ghost they'll become human, and vice-versa. The pirate they pick is revealed to the whole team, so they have to be confident about their choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/50b21ca185419af2aaf7c39f1f8a97c24047b1d0.png[/img]
Using The Shapeshifter's Switch will also use up one of The Shapeshifter's charges, meaning they can shift their shape one fewer time. Will they be willing to sacrifice a charge for greater good - or to cause mass chaos?

[h2]Wishlist An Elaborate History of Chess on Steam now![/h2]
We've had a bit of a touch-up here and there, and we've replaced all of the older Iteration Games logos with our shiny new, all-blue logo! There's also a little reminder at the bottom of the title screen letting you know about our next game, An Elaborate History of Chess, coming soon on Steam. Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255020/An_Elaborate_History_of_Chess/

[h2]Join the Paper Pirates Community[/h2]
As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm GMT on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/IterationGames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/IterationGames]YouTube channel[/url] to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3RDkuJ58Xb]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Haunted Seas - Halloween Event!
notes.notes:
[h1]Set Sail on Haunted Seas for Halloween![/h1]
Throughout October, celebrate Paper Pirates’ spookiest seasonal event by taking part in the Halloween-themed Haunted Seas event! Running from 1st October - 31st October, a whole host of spooky goings on are waiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8f5a4cd5176fe5e295bc36e3e12381c344f92068.png[/img]
[h2]Seasonal Trait+: The Vampires[/h2]
Play a Traits+ game during Haunted Seas, and you might find a spooky new Traits+ exclusive passive trait has joined the crew. When a pirate starts the game as The Vampire, a special day one event, The Vampire's Bite, will automatically trigger. During this event, The Vampire can choose any other pirate - immediately turning that pirate's passive trait into The Vampire too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5828e4ce7a0ef0e99f208622f3d0254cabe38c3b.png[/img]
The two vampires then have a unique victory condition they can achieve: Every time either vampire votes to throw a pirate overboard, they will feed on that pirate, gaining power. Once fed on, that pirate cannot be fed on again by either vampire.

If The Vampires are able to successfully throw all other pirates overboard, they will reach maximum power - causing the voyage to immediately end, and declaring the two pirates with The Vampire passive trait as the only winners.

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Werewolf[/h2]
Available in all trait games during Haunted Seas is the spooky passive trait, [b]The Werewolf[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/123f775869702a400c67a224b1cb567de6603cfe.png[/img]
On odd numbered days, when the moon is in its crescent phase, The Werewolf is weakened. Any votes cast by The Werewolf on these days will only have a voting power of one, regardless of their rank on the ship.

However, on even numbered days, when the moon is full, The Werewolf is strengthened! Any votes cast by The Werewolf on these days will have double their usual voting power. Yikes! They might even start throwing people overboard all on their own...

Will you get hunted by The Werewolf?

[h2]Trick or Treat?[/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during the Haunted Seas event, and the Halloween Spirits may appear to one of the crew. During the Event phase of the game, the Trick or Treat? event may activate for the duration of Haunted Seas, offering a randomly chosen pirate a choice. Will they take the easy option and choose a treat, or are they feeling brave and willing to risk a trick?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/83b9867ad29678ceb6b3d06a8a1aed45a45c2591.png[/img]
[h2]Be Surprised by the Audience![/h2]
If an audience is observing your voyage during Haunted Seas, they might find themselves empowered with a surprise. The 'Audience Surprise' seasonal event asks the audience whether they'd like to surprise the crew with either a trick, or a treat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b4a24a7682a0923a163433e97e53ddd3e5d5f1fa.png[/img]
If more of the audience choose trick, an event which generally favours the ghost team will immediately happen. If more of the audience choose treat, an event which generally favours the human team will immediately happen.

Will your audience surprise you with a lovely treat, or a mischievous trick?

[h2]Limited Time Customisation Options[/h2]
During Haunted Seas, Sam Sherbot and Nat O’Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Haunted Seas, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/bf3663da633a4cf52ba84c3ac12eda157c3bd49a.png[/img]
The full list of Ship Shop items available during Haunted Seas is:

notes.title: Oktoberfest on the Ocean!
notes.notes:
[h2]Grab a sausage and celebrate Oktoberfest![/h2]
As we see out September, we’re celebrating the ninth Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Oktoberfest on the Ocean![/b] Running from 18th to 30th September, celebrating the end of the season with a shindig dedicated to pretzels, sausages, chicken dancing and more, with a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/720202839e34853acc958150d577a4c93755ed89.png[/img]
[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Brewmaster[/h2]
The Brewmaster is here, and they're ready to get the party started! When you have a Brewmaster aboard, they'll be asked to set the vibe of the ship during the first day. Whichever vibe they choose will mix up the Paper Pirates voting rules! New for 2024, The Brewmaster has two brand new vibes to experiment with.

There are a total of six vibes The Brewmaster can pick for the ship:
[list]
[*] [b]Aggressive Vibes[/b] - Grants each pirate one additional voting power
[*] [b]Chaotic Vibes[/b] - Instead of voting from Stowaway to Captain, the crew will vote in a randomised order each day
[*] [b]Commanding Vibes (new)[/b] - Voting each day will follow 'Majority Rules', where each pirate has one voting power and the pirate with the most votes goes overboard
[*] [b]Determined Vibes[/b] - Removes the crew's ability to pass their vote
[*] [b]Energetic Vibes[/b] - If nobody has gone overboard after the Captain has voted, a second round of voting begins. Votes from the previous round carry forward
[*] [b]Secretive Vibes (new)[/b] - When a pirate casts a vote, the crew will not see who they voted for
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/99f1a2410f59672aa2f09aac190a735498f58869.png[/img]
Every voyage, The Brewmaster will be given a random selection of [b]four [/b]out of the six vibes to choose. Whichever vibe they pick will stay in effect for the rest of the voyage. However, each day The Brewmaster doesn't play in, they can choose to change up the vibe, and bring a new mood to the party. How will having The Brewmaster aboard change the way your crew votes people over?

notes.title: The Traits+ Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Game Mode: Traits+[/h2]
We're super excited to launch our first new game mode since we introduced Traits way back in March 2021. Paper Pirates' new game mode, [b]Traits+[/b], is a whole new way to sail with traits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c2772102c57b38eaf766cb7587b611611ff143ff.png[/img]
When playing a Traits+ game, each crewmate will be given TWO traits - one active, and one passive. Active traits are traits that typically do something during the job phase when you either do, or don't, play in for a job. Think things like The Meddler, The Shapeshifter, and The Brawler. Passive traits are traits that are typically always in play. Think things like The Pure, The Tainted, and The Contrarian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/32bdf69bee7a8340676d9967eb46df111b2c9c5e.png[/img]
We've updated the Captain's Log and the game customisation screen to clearly list which traits are active and which are passive. If your voyage configuration doesn't have enough active or passive traits to go round the whole crew, some of the pirates might be declared Innocent (in place of a passive trait), or Inactive (in place of an active trait).

Traits+ offers a whole new strategic layer to Paper Pirates, with over [b]three hundred[/b] potential combinations. Will your traits work well with each other? Will they force you to side with the human team, or the ghost team? Will they pull you in two different directions? And how will you ever know who you can trust.

[h2]New Trait: The Traders[/h2]
Our very first Traits+ exclusive Trait is [b]The Traders[/b], an active trait that always appears as a pair. The two pirates with The Traders can activate their shared ability any time either of them is not a job.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/aee7dc7ec05fe679e3af2f5d1a9ed4a86f85ef00.png[/img]
When activated, The Traders will exchange their passive traits with each other. When the traits swap, they carry all their charges, accumulated stats, and information with them. This opens up a raft of new strategic potential!

Be warned though... The Traders power only requires one of the two Traders to activate it, so if you're the second Trader, you might find yourself in an endless tug-of-war with your companion for a good passive trait!

[h2]New Trait: The Manipulator[/h2]
[b]The Manipulator[/b] is a new active trait appearing in both Trait and Traits+ game modes. The Manipulator's powerful ability allows them to target a pirate on days when they don't play in and force them to vote for a specific pirate the next time they vote.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e0cfdf2a05ac3d55e4b0709a0b0e3e61f79d5563.png[/img]
The Manipulator can use their power three times per voyage, and their power lasts until that player next votes, and also removes that pirate's option to pass their vote. The Manipulator could control of The Assassin to utilise them to nefarious means, take control of a mid-ship ghost engine, or force the Captain to vote for the Stowaway. The options are endless!

[h2]New Trait: The Retaliator[/h2]
[b]The Retaliator[/b] is a new passive trait appearing in both Trait and Traits+ game modes. The Retaliator's base voting power is always increased by the number of votes currently cast against them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fbc7934d4d34eff73f083e5683d6af31e7b4a0e1.png[/img]
The Retaliator's strength comes in taking revenge on those pirates that vote against them, but, it also has a raft of strategic potential. If you're willing to co-operate with other pirates, you could pool all your votes onto The Retaliator, concentrating the potential possession targets if you accidentally vote over a human...

But be careful, The Retaliator could always use all that accumulated voting power right back at you...

[h2]New Trait: The Torn[/h2]
[b]The Torn[/b] is a new passive trait appearing in both Trait and Traits+ game modes. When it's The Torn's turn to vote, they have the opportunity to vote twice! Each vote has half their base voting power (rounded up).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6fcd6a2ed3efa59cab02c6ee07b2f92c590b016e.png[/img]
The Torn can use each of their votes however they like. They can pass them both, use each one on a different pirate, the same pirate, or even use one and then pass the other. This allows them to be a little safer when throwing someone overboard, or to hedge their bets if they're just not sure.

[h2]New Event: Change of Trait[/h2]
[b]Change of Trait[/b] is a new event appearing only in Traits+ games. When a Change of Trait happens, a randomly chosen pirate will be offered the opportunity to change their passive trait. If they choose to accept, their passive trait will immediately change into a new passive trait that isn't already claimed by anyone else on the ship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/648fa8fde47e309b67076e74af1316f885af61b3.png[/img]
The Change of Trait pirate doesn't get to see which passive trait they'll get in advance, so it's always risky. Watch out after a Change of Trait event - could a pirate have just become The Tainted?

[h2]Five New Achievements[/h2]
With new content comes new achievements, and with new achievements comes new hats! There are five new tasks for you to complete to earn a lovely bounty of new hats for your crew to enjoy. The new achievements are:

[list]
[*] [b]A Traitorous Sequel[/b]: Play a Traits+ Game
[*] [b]Murderous Mind Games[/b]: As The Manipulator, force another pirate to throw you overboard
[*] [b]The Retaliator's Revenge[/b]: As The Retaliator, throw a pirate who voted for you overboard
[*] [b]Proficient Prognosis[/b]: As The Psychic, correctly predict which pirate will next go overboard in a The Psychic's Prediction event
[*] [b]Top and Tail[/b]: As The Traders, trade traits while occupying the Captain and Stowaway ranks
[/list]
[h2]Time Warp in Trait and Traits+ Games[/h2]
With Traits+ offering the opportunity to be really playful with traits, we've updated the Time Warp event to now impact traits in both Trait and Traits+ game modes. This means that a Time Warp will now revert any trait progress, but also restores any charges spent in the aborted timeline. This means that The Witch recovers their used ingredients, The Legion might lose or gain ghosts, The Undecided might lose their current trait, and much more.

Make sure to check your Black Spot after a Time Warp to check who - or what - you even are...!

[h2]Trait Player Count Requirement Updates[/h2]
We've reviewed the player count requirements for all traits, mostly bringing more advanced traits into smaller games. This will help games to feel fresh and exciting no matter how big your crews, and helps to balance the active and passive traits available to all crew sizes. We'll keep this under review, making changes where necessary.

notes.title: The Verdant Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Traits and New Events![/h1]
In this Paper Pirates update, we've added two brand new never-seen-before traits to the permanent roster of traits. We've also added two new events and two new trait events!

[h2]New Trait: The Gardener[/h2]
The Gardener is the first of our two new traits. The Gardener has access to three plant pots, and they can choose which plant to tend each day that they don't play in. There are four different plants that The Gardener might grow, so each voyage they'll only have a selection of a few!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/2f9bb6f941c5a2d0a9c0d446f7648bdc7c9e198e.png[/img]
After a plant has been tended three times, it'll be fully grown, and will activate an ongoing effect that impacts the whole crew. From Saintly Sunflowers to Clingy Cacti, each plant is sure to turn the tide in the favour of one team or the either. Will The Gardener learn to work with their plants, or will they turn against them?

[h2]New Trait: The Undecided[/h2]
The Undecided is the second of our new traits. The Undecided doesn't actually start with a trait! Each day, when The Undecided doesn't play in, they'll be offered a trait that's enabled for the voyage but which no other pirate currently has.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/1f80438a023ce3506b7f9ff07cbd79ede7ea838d.png[/img]
Should they chose to accept this trait, The Undecided will then become that trait for the remainder of the voyage. Alternatively, they can pass on it, and hope that another trait comes along another day.

Whether The Undecided is taking advantage of becoming a trait that the crew needs just at the right time, or, finding out which traits are not currently on board the ship, they're sure to add some spice to your voyage!

[h2]New Trait Events[/h2]
Building on the six trait events that were added in the last update, we've added another two - this time for The Psychic and The Cursed.

[h3]The Psychic's Prediction[/h3]
In The Psychic's Prediction, The Psychic takes a guess at which pirate they think will next go overboard. If they ace their prediction, showing off their psychic abilities, they'll be rewarded with a choice of either moving the ship one space closer to shore or throwing a treasure overboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/94392131608f1f44daab5cf992f473dcf73eed98.png[/img]
[h3]The Cursed's Calamity[/h3]
In The Cursed's Calamity, The Cursed will have an opportunity to potentially get thrown overboard. They'll be given a Magic Lamp-style event, but where the options are always Scurvy, Hot Potato, or Overpower. Which of these will give them the best chance of going overboard?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/3fe86b139f65967c0c715369cc8e18345c672546.png[/img]
[h2]New Event: Reinvigoration[/h2]
If the crew encounters a Reinvigoration event during a Trait game, any active trait that uses charges is sure to be celebrating - for they'll be gaining an extra charge for use during the remainder of the voyage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/15a84ef1706f9356e98aa37aacf337ab5e417cba.png[/img]
[h2]New Event: Confession[/h2]
When a Confession event happens, one pirate from the crew is randomly chosen to share their deepest secret - which team they're on - with another pirate. They can't opt out so they have to pick someone they trust. Whoever they choose will get to find out whether the confessing pirate is a ghost or a human... but beware! In Trait games, Traits like The Disguised will still impact the outcome of the event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4b3eec1086d144b575507dbf6ad3805628ce854d.png[/img]
[h2]Wishlist An Elaborate History of Chess on Steam now![/h2]
We've had a bit of a touch-up here and there, and we've replaced all of the older Iteration Games logos with our shiny new, all-blue logo! There's also a little reminder at the bottom of the title screen letting you know about our next game, An Elaborate History of Chess, coming soon on Steam. Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255020/An_Elaborate_History_of_Chess/
[h2]Join the Paper Pirates Community[/h2]
As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm GMT on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/IterationGames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/IterationGames]YouTube channel[/url] to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3RDkuJ58Xb]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Spring Sailing!
notes.notes:
[h2]Go Egg Hunting on the Seven Seas with Spring Sailing![/h2]
Across March and April, we’re celebrating with the Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Spring Sailing![/b] Running from 15th March - 12th April, celebrate the season of spring with a festival of eggs, bunnies, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7bc993124ffd3af4fe1d9aa6b2a729c3f5e8c0b8.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Spring Chicken[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a9061627fa02d98b144147b96d32307494593ccf.png[/img]

notes.title: The Trait Events Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Reworked Traits and New Events to spice up every voyage![/h1]
In this Paper Pirates update, we've reworked three traits to make them more desirable and give them more influence. There's also a whole host of new events for you to find to ensure that no two voyages are ever the same!

[h2]Reworked Trait: The Gifted[/h2]
We love that The Gifted has a lot more control when they're the captain, and it's great how much control over the game being able to choose from three jobs gives you. However, not every Gifted finds their way to captaincy in every game, so we wanted to give The Gifted a little more to their toolkit to give them some oomph in games where they don't make it to the top of the ship.

The Gifted retains their ability to choose three jobs when they're the captain, but in addition, now has the ability to override the captain's job choice once per voyage with any job the crew are able to carry out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4b712e9b177d16f00a609f9558b1e757b75cfd65.png[/img]
Each day, The Gifted will see a large button on their device. If they press it, the captain's job choice will be interrupted, and they can choose any job which will happen that day. The captain still gets to choose whether they want to obey or disobey.

The Gifted can use their job choice strategically to make sure the job goes in their favour. Perhaps they want to definitely exclude, or even include, someone on the ghost team. Perhaps they want to work in partnership with an active trait to exclude them from a job - or stop them using their power by putting them in a job!

[h2]Reworked Trait: The Thief[/h2]
When we made The Thief, we hoped it would be used as a vote deterrent so that ghosts had a way to try to avoid being voted overboard. The threat of losing a treasure versus the bonus of removing a ghost didn't have quite as much impact on games as we'd like, so we've reworked The Thief to make it more impactful.

When The Thief is chosen to play in for a job, they may choose to attempt a thievery. Once the job is resolved, the crew will be notified that there was an attempted thievery during the job. If The Thief is lucky, they'll steal a treasure from the crew and, as an added bonus, immediately turn into a ghost. If The Thief is unlucky, the crew will know an attempted thievery took place, but no treasure will be lost and The Thief will remain human.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9ff2d382009dd1cee49a9bdf6a5c3161640570f5.png[/img]
The Thief can only attempt a thievery while they're on the human team, so once you identify your thief, you might want to think carefully about how you deal with them!

[h2]Reworked Trait: The Medium[/h2]
We love that The Medium adds a level of private information sharing to a voyage, but, with untargeted messaging it was sometimes difficult to use it effectively.

We've changed the way The Medium works, such that on days when they don't play in they may now choose any individual pirate to send a private message to. After the day's job has resolved, The Medium's message will be sent to their chosen pirate and most importantly, that pirate will then have the chance to send a secret message back to The Medium.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e974b0946d2d6964b8bb290554d95dada6e04072.png[/img]
This change empowers The Medium to become a master of secrets. Can they steal a secret from another pirate that gives them more power over the crew? Perhaps they want to share a secret about themselves with someone they trust?

[h2]New Event: Two of a Kind[/h2]
The new [b]Two of a Kind[/b] event is designed to help the crew out in a moment of need, giving them the opportunity to find out some more information. When a Two of a Kind event happens, a randomly chosen pirate is offered a choice of two pirates from the ship - including themselves but excluding the Stowaway.

The whole crew will see which two pirates were chosen, and then discover whether those two pirates are either both on the same team, or, on different teams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/0884071a83252e5511e756ae720706642be51ae5.png[/img]
This is an opportunity to find out a little information about two teams, or, if you're on the ghost team, a chance to spread some real deception amongst the crew. Even if you know two people are on the same team, can you trust them...?

[h2]New Event: Trap of the Tainted[/h2]
Trap of the Tainted is a brand new event that only appears in Trait games, and can only happen when someone on the crew is The Tainted.

In the initial phase of Trap of the Tainted, the pirate with the Tainted trait chooses any three pirates - including themselves - to lure into a dark and dangerous dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b34d3dc9ca4e619f38c25e392b14e7976fdbd5d8.png[/img]
Once three pirates have been chosen, every other member of the crew, one by one, must choose which of them they'd like to leave behind in the dungeon. Being left behind in the dungeon is effectively the same as going overboard, so that pirate will return to the ship as a new stowaway and, if they were human, one of the pirates that voted for them will join the ghost team.

[h2]New Trait Events[/h2]
We've added six brand new events which can only appear in Trait games which are themed around some of the existing traits, allowing a pirate with that trait the opportunity to influence the crew's voyage. Look out for any of the following events:

[list]
[*] The Berserker's Barrage
[*] The Legion's Liaison
[*] The Pure's Cure
[*] The Sensitive's Shuffle
[*] The Tainted's Touch
[*] The Twins' Tricks
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4ff7c6d56a4b4ab6b1a60807c31d38ac2062e6d0.png[/img]
When one of these events shows up, you not only know that someone with that trait must be aboard the ship, you're also bound to experience some shenanigans sure to make you think twice about your fellow crewmates.

[h2]New Audience Event: Audience Influence[/h2]
We've added a new audience event, Audience Influence! When an Audience Influence event happens, The Audience may collectively choose any pirate from the crew. The pirate who receives the most votes will become cursed, and will receive a small number of votes from the audience at the start of every voting round each day until a pirate is successfully voted overboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9c0c5f88688e227c75a2a886235a00bc6a637ad1.png[/img]
[h2]Wishlist An Elaborate History of Chess on Steam now![/h2]
We've had a bit of a touch-up here and there, and we've replaced all of the older Iteration Games logos with our shiny new, all-blue logo! There's also a little reminder at the bottom of the title screen letting you know about our next game, An Elaborate History of Chess, coming soon on Steam. Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255020/An_Elaborate_History_of_Chess/

[h2]Join the Paper Pirates Community[/h2]
As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm GMT on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/IterationGames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/IterationGames]YouTube channel[/url] to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3RDkuJ58Xb]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Soggy Hogmanay Community Bounty Achieved!
notes.notes:
Happy new year, crew!

We've started 2024 off strongly, with a really impressive completion time on the Soggy Hogmanay Community Bounty. Because we collectively played 100 games of Paper Pirates in the first week of 2024, there's a unique reward that all pirates can claim in-game now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a03270dda1f0712cf149421bc50665920cdf57f0.png[/img]

Make sure to open Paper Pirates before Wednesday 24th January 2024 to claim the Dragon (Coat). Although the redemption ends in late January, if you open the box and claim your Dragon now, you can keep it forever!

Once you've claimed the Dragon, any pirates joining games you host will be able to equip the Dragon in the Coat outfit slot. The Dragon is super cute, comes in a range of colours, and although their wings are mighty they're not quite strong enough to prevent you from going overboard. They're only a little Dragon after all!

We hope everyone in the Paper Pirates community has a fantastic 2024, and we'll keep you updated with game updates and seasonal celebrations as the year rolls on.

Thanks as always for your support,
Iteration Games

Those pirates who make it back first are granted good fortune for the coming voyage - and will be given a higher rank on the ship accordingly! Have your devices at the ready and press a button as soon as it appears, and any pirate has the chance of seizing the rank of captain!
