notes.title: Yule Tides!
notes.notes:
[h2]Prepare for Merriment and Mischief on the Yule Tides![/h2]
Throughout all of December, we’re celebrating, sharing, and gift giving, with Yule Tides! Running from 1st December - 31st December, celebrate Christmas with a festival of merriment and joy, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ce7d805bff1f386e8111f2c09c94c1b41d822635.png[/img]

[h2]New Permanent Event: Majority Rule[/h2]
With this year's Yule Tides comes the addition of a brand new, all-year-round event, [b]Majority Rule[/b]. When Majority Rule triggers, the voting rules will change until a pirate next goes overboard. Every pirate's base voting power will be set to [b]one[/b], and the voting threshold is [b]removed[/b]. At the end of the day, the pirate with the most votes goes overboard - even if that's only one vote!

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Gift Giver[/h2]
The special seasonal trait for Yule Tides is [b]The Gift Giver[/b]! Play a trait game during Yule Tides and one of the pirates may find themselves playing as The Gift Giver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7929060f5af8c6cb0856a185b84d06130c95533e.png[/img]

The Gift Giver is offered a present to gift to a pirate of their choice on every day when they don't play in. There are a range of different gifts, but which one you get to give is random each day! You can only give three gifts on each voyage - and to make things even more tricky, each pirate can only receive a gift once.

Will you get the gifts you need to sail to success? Or will you accidentally end up giving away a victory to the ghosts.

[h2]Advent Bounties[/h2]
During the Christmas season, the bounty board is celebrating each and every day that passes! Each day throughout December, you’ll receive a special Advent Bounty, with a challenge for you to complete! If you complete an advent bounty, you'll be rewarded with a special Paper Pirates Present! There are [b]eleven[/b] items for you to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9157c2f873325f7c5cc3a45c5361bab923c99bc6.png[/img]

The advent bounties are time-limited, so you have to complete them on the day you get them - but don’t worry if you don’t, there’ll be a new one waiting for you tomorrow!

[h2]A Special Christmas Present[/h2]
There's a special Christmas bounty, available to every good pirate! All you need to do to complete it is have [b]five[/b] Snowball Fights during Yule Tides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f49583193c64dc844cf7e220025b20e43957f134.png[/img]

Completing the bounty will unlock a special outfit reward for all pirates to use permanently!

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]
During Yule Tides, Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Yule Tides, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b944860d45972c0029b60417385dbeee90998b27.png[/img]

Once the event’s over, the hats will disappear from your collection until next year, so be sure to wear them while you can!

[h2]Seasonal Event: Cracking Crackers[/h2]
While sailing on the even seas during Yule Tides, you might find the crew getting a little rowdy with all the partying and merriment! Encounter the Cracking Crackers event, and two members of your crew will decide to pull a giant size festive cracker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9bdae9e3c239ee0e1156d6724abbd3f1df7400eb.png[/img]

Hit the button on your device more times than your opponent to claim the bigger half of the cracker - and save yourself from certain doom, as the loser will be flung overboard from the force of the cracker's explosion! Watch out though, if the losing pirate was a human, the one walking away with the bigger piece will now be a ghost...

[h2]Seasonal Event: Snowball Fight![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Yule Tides, and each day there is a chance it may begin to snow giving the crew the opportunity to partake in a little festive fun - a traditional snowball fight! When Snowball Fight is triggered, each member of the crew must choose who to pelt with a snowball. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/24388077cf067ade639f06b6876e6bbec1727222.png[/img]

The pirate who receives the most snowballs will be thrown overboard! Who will you throw your snowball at? When they go overboard, if they’re a human, one of the people who threw the snowball will become a ghost… so choose wisely!

[h2]Seasonal Event: Naughty or Nice?[/h2]
During your Yule Tides sailing adventures, you may encounter the ‘Naughty or Nice’ event during the event phase of the game. In ‘Naughty or Nice’, one member of the crew must offer a gift to another. Question is - has the receiver been naughty, or nice? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a791b387abde0a64441d7f63daa58776158a55af.png[/img]

The present-giver must decide, with a host of fun positive outcomes for nice, and some meaner tricks for naughty. When the receiver is given the gift, they can choose whether to open it, or discard it. Do you think your crewmate has sent you something nice, or are they a ghost, hoping to catch you out? That’s all part of festive deception!

[h2]Yule Tidings come to the Photo Booth[/h2]
To celebrate the season, there are a small number of limited-time Foils and Backgrounds available in the Photo Booth, in the Captain’s Log. Take the opportunity to snap your favourite pirate templates with a little festive frivolity, and don’t forget to share any pics you take! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/98e048142b81c885db30524f3a4cd52800cb4c3b.png[/img]

[h2]Yule Tides Bots[/h2]
Invite some bots into your game during Yule Tides, and you may find some of the regular crew replaced with some particularly festive bots, out to celebrate Christmas! They’ll only join your games during Yule Tides, but each has their own personality and appearance for you to enjoy.

notes.title: The Festive Feast!
notes.notes:
[h2]What are you thankful for during the Festive Feast Event?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/486b22700b2487a0e95890a90c2acf3fe46c2721.png[/img]

Through the second half of November, we’re taking some time to be thankful in our most delicious seasonal event, The Festive Feast! Running from 16th November - 30th November, celebrate the harvest season with a festival of feasting and thankfulness and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Quarterback[/h2]
Our seasonal trait for The Festive Feast is [b]The Quarterback[/b]! The Quarterback is gifted with an exploding football, and knows exactly how many days the football will take to explode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5590d9f073908136bbc1b337f5ceac6074a2a4e6.png[/img]

They may pass the ball to any other pirate, who then has the chance to either pass it on to another pirate or keep hold of it in the pre-event phase of the next day. The Quarterback will always know exactly how many days there are until the football explodes, throwing the pirate currently holding it overboard. Can you trust The Quarterback's timings, or will you find yourself blown up by their lies?

[h2]Make a Wish Every Day[/h2]
Play Paper Pirates during The Festive Feast and you can make a festive wish once per day! Play at least one game, and after your voyage you'll receive a gift from the bounty board!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b58b98a0ba216c90b460848e704d94a91e1d0b70.png[/img]

There are five American football-themed outfit pieces for you to collect from the daily quests, so make sure to play a game of Paper Pirates on five different days before the celebration ends on the 30th November!

[h2]Special Harvest Bounty[/h2]
New to the Festive Feast for 2023, there is a special [b]harvest[/b] bounty. To complete the bounty, you need to play [b]five[/b] games, of any mode, during the Festive Feast. Upon completion, you'll get a special treat...

It's quite the surprise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/41707840a9d489d9e44b110e29802af0762bf256.png[/img]

notes.title: Día de Muertos - Day of the Dead Event!

[h1]Honour the Spirits of the Dead during Día de Muertos![/h1]

notes.title: Haunted Seas - Halloween Event!
notes.notes:
[h1]Set Sail on Haunted Seas for Halloween![/h1]
Throughout October, celebrate Paper Pirates’ spookiest seasonal event by taking part in the Halloween-themed Haunted Seas event! Running from 1st October - 31st October, a whole host of spooky goings on are waiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8f5a4cd5176fe5e295bc36e3e12381c344f92068.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Werewolf[/h2]
Our seasonal trait for Haunted Seas is [b]The Werewolf[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/123f775869702a400c67a224b1cb567de6603cfe.png[/img]

On odd numbered days, when the moon is in its crescent phase, The Werewolf is weakened. Any votes cast by The Werewolf on these days will only have a voting power of one, regardless of their rank on the ship.

However, on even numbered days, when the moon is full, The Werewolf is strengthened! Any votes cast by The Werewolf on these days will have double their usual voting power. Yikes! They might even start throwing people overboard all on their own...

Will you get hunted by The Werewolf?

notes.title: Oktoberfest on the Ocean!
notes.notes:
[h2]Grab a sausage and celebrate Oktoberfest![/h2]
As we see out September, we’re celebrating the ninth Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Oktoberfest on the Ocean![/b] Running from 18th to 30th September, celebrate the end of the season with a shindig dedicated to pretzels, sausages, chicken dancing and more, with a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9725aeae9559a1d9301861d0ae10159c236573be.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Brewmaster[/h2]
The Brewmaster is here, and they're ready to get the party started! When you have a Brewmaster aboard, they'll be asked to set the vibe of the ship during the first day. Whichever vibe they choose will mix up the Paper Pirates voting rules!

There are a total of four vibes The Brewmaster can pick for the ship:
[list]
[*] [b]Aggressive Vibes[/b] - Grants each pirate one additional voting power
[*] [b]Chaotic Vibes[/b] - Instead of voting from Stowaway to Captain, the crew will vote in a randomised order each day
[*] [b]Determined Vibes[/b] - Removes the crew's ability to pass their vote
[*] [b]Energetic Vibes[/b] - If nobody has gone overboard after the Captain has voted, a second round of voting begins. Votes from the previous round carry forward!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/99f1a2410f59672aa2f09aac190a735498f58869.png[/img]

Whichever vibe they pick will stay in effect for the rest of the voyage. However, each day The Brewmaster doesn't play in, they can choose to change up the vibe, and bring a new mood to the party. How will having The Brewmaster aboard change the way your crew votes people over?

[h2]The band is here![/h2]
To help get the party started, a collection of instruments brand new for Oktoberfest 2023 will be available at Sam Sherbot's Outfit Shop aboard the Ship Shop for the duration of Oktoberfest on the Ocean. Instruments can be worn by pirates in either the Hand or the Belt outfit slots, depending on the instrument type, and there's enough for everyone on even the biggest crews to grab a different instrument!

notes.title: History and Mystery Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Recap your voyage in more detail with the History and Mystery Update![/h1]
Jump aboard Paper Pirates to explore the History and Mystery Update, featuring a refreshed game history feature, two new traits, a new event, and more!

[h2]New and Improved Game History[/h2]
Our end-of-game recap screen, the Game History, was built for a simpler time when pirates didn't have things like traits. Although it's grown with us over time, it was starting to fall behind in providing a transparent recap of everything that happened in the game. So, we rebuilt it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e9e87240ffa84aa4453400a2854a011fb5af42e9.png[/img]
The new Game History includes more precise details, such as letting you know who voted for a Mutiny, as well as better handling of trait-influenced team changes and clearer indicators of when team changes happen.

Each day, you can review the job and who played in, see a summary of the events that took place, and check the outcome of voting. If you want to dig a little deeper, the details panel on the right will walk you through the day in detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8cbc6e47ed29d82a929b96b29e140b6599954315.png[/img]
You can also check who voted for who, who became a ghost, and what the probabilities were, in the Voting Chart!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/d2c472098870247bd36d8e2624f0f13924575029.png[/img]
Last but not least, there's a bigger, bolder, and better final page in the Game History that more clearly indicates who on the crew were on the winning team. Open up the chart here and you can see exactly how your game played out over time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9bf2fe48eab24b5603da358efbe89d7c3d59067b.png[/img]
We love the new Game History and hope that it will help you better dissect your games. This was a huge project given the variety of voyages, and there might be the odd event or outcome that's missing text. We'll be keeping our eye out and patching these up as we go!

[h2]New Trait: The Silent[/h2]
One of two new traits for the History and Mystery Update is [b]The Silent[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4151876c78c61ac4fa1a59afaa78ebb86521a5e0.png[/img]
The Silent's votes are always secret. That means it will always appear as if they passed their vote, even if they didn't. Should The Silent cast enough votes to throw someone overboard, the voting will still end immediately. If you're The Silent and want to stay hidden, make sure you're casting votes where you won't be exposed.

And if you're not The Silent? Be wary. Joke votes sink boats! And with The Silent on board, you can never know exactly who might have been ghosted when a human goes overboard...

[h2]New Trait: The Gambler[/h2]
Another new trait for the History and Mystery Update is [b]The Gambler[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/3a916a745bf499cd6107a667d289ef9fc51c5a69.png[/img]
On days when they don't play in, The Gambler is offered two events. One of these will have a high chance of happening, and one of them will have a low chance of happening. Whether The Gambler is a ghost or a human, the high-chance event will normally be good for their team, while the low-chance event will be bad for their team.

Are you willing to take a risk on a good event knowing what bad things might happen? Can you get away with risking it all and claiming that your events were the other way round?

Whether on the ghost team or the human team, The Gambler is sure to have you questioning whether you feel lucky!

[h2]New Event: Counting the Treasure[/h2]
Our new event for the History and Mystery update is [b]Counting the Treasure[/b]!

In a Counting the Treasure event, one pirate will be randomly selected to take on responsibility for counting the treasure. But never fear, they'll have help from three other pirates! Those three pirates will all see a number of coins on their device: Either 1, 2, or 3 coins. Their job is to tell the counting pirate how many coins they can see, so the counting pirate can add them up and report the total on their device.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b372fcde542f1bb1d67eaa8184cbf08e6559dec2.png[/img]
If you count correctly - amazing! The crew get another treasure! However, if you get it wrong, in the confusion it seems one of your current treasure will be whisked away before you can know it.

How much do you trust the three pirates chosen to help count the treasure? If it all goes wrong, who will you blame...?

[h2]Wishlist An Elaborate History of Chess on Steam now![/h2]
We've had a bit of a touch-up here and there, and we've replaced all of the older Iteration Games logos with our shiny new, all-blue logo! There's also a little reminder at the bottom of the title screen letting you know about our next game, An Elaborate History of Chess, coming soon on Steam. Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255020/An_Elaborate_History_of_Chess/

[h2]Join the Paper Pirates Community[/h2]
As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm GMT on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/IterationGames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/IterationGames]YouTube channel[/url] to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3RDkuJ58Xb]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Announcing An Elaborate History of Chess!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the next game from Iteration Games, [b]An Elaborate History of Chess[/b]!

[previewyoutube=rztp0qf-4So;full][/previewyoutube]

An Elaborate History of Chess is a blend of real-time and turn-based strategy, exploring the history of the popular board game, Chess. Start with just one lowly pawn to begin building your village, and work your way up to an entire kingdom. Keep your farms running like clockwork to ensure a food supply for your pieces, and see how far you can spread your influence.

As your kingdom flourishes, you'll attract all sorts of wildlife and monsters looking to checkmate your best warriors and take your wheat for themselves. Don't forget to build your defences, set up your supply chains, and of course, protect the king!

When you're feeling brave it's time to turn your attention to the dungeons. You'll need to prepare an adventuring party ready to face the horrors and puzzles that lie in wait in the time-frozen dungeons, where you'll need to show your mastery of chess strategy to overcome the myriad challenges that lie await and steal the very best treasures.

Do you have what it takes to become grandmaster of all you see, or will you find your best gambits just don't pay off?

You can wishlist An Elaborate History of Chess on Steam now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255020/An_Elaborate_History_of_Chess/

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards now Available!
notes.notes:
We're super thrilled that Paper Pirates now has a full set of Steam Trading Cards available to anyone who buys the game. Steam Trading Cards are granted randomly to players as they play. We've themed the Trading Cards around the bots, so look out for all of your favourite Paper Pirates characters and make sure to trade with your friends to get the ones you really love!

Collecting a full set of Steam Trading Cards awards a badge, which you can display on your Steam profile, and also grants you access to some Paper Pirates themed emotes you can use throughout Steam chat and Steam profile backgrounds you can use to fancy up your Steam profile. You can even collect additional sets to level up your badge, and earn even more goodies!

If you're super lucky, you might find a Foil card with a special frame. These are especially rare and definitely worth keeping an eye out for!

We hope everyone has fun collecting and trading Steam Trading Cards while playing Paper Pirates, and we'll see you all again soon out there on the ocean!

notes.title: All Together Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Set Sail with Random Players with the All Together Update![/h1]
Jump aboard Paper Pirates to explore the All Together Update, featuring a new trait, public listing for games and more!

[h2]Public Games[/h2]
When creating a Paper Pirates lobby, you now have the option of advertising your game publicly. Tick the "Public Games" tick box from the game customisation screen, and your lobby will be advertised for anyone to join via Spectator mode. Players joining public games will still have to join via a web browser on a connected device, but public games offer a way to recruit a crew even when playing solo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7a9b57de30d951e7d19fcef732a42509554dcccd.png[/img]

Remember, you can always [b]mute[/b] or [b]kick[/b] a pirate who joins your game and misbehaves to stop them contributing to the game any further. To do so, just click on a pirate in-game and choose the mute or kick option as appropriate. You can even do this from a lobby!

If you're looking to find more pirates to join your games, you're always welcome to join the Paper Pirates Discord server where you can advertise your games for anyone to join.

[h2]Mid-Game Spectating[/h2]
To enhance the spectating experience, we've tightened up a few screws and enabled spectating mid-game. Whenever you join, you will have to wait for the start of the next day, but then your spectated game will be perfectly in sync with the host! You'll still get all the coins for the whole voyage, but note that your Round History will only display days for which you were already spectating.

[h2]New Trait: The Legion[/h2]
Our new trait for the All Together Update is [b]The Legion[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/1e567ce1aea41b9447ea650af77757847ef532ba.png[/img]

The Legion is a trait that is always assigned to a ghost at the start of a game, just like The Tainted. Whenever the Legion would become a ghost while a ghost, an extra ghost joins their collection. If they would become a human, one of the ghosts leaves their collection, but they remain a ghost. The only way to cleanse The Legion and return them to humanity is to clear their entire ghost collection!

The Legion always starts the game with one extra ghost in their collection, so at the very least you'll need to get them overboard twice, or give them two exorcisms, before they turn human. Never trust when you think someone is a human, because they could be The Legion!

[h2]New Trait: The Sleuth[/h2]
As a reward for finding clues during Steam Mystery Fest, the collective efforts of pirates across the entire ocean unlocked a new Trait, The Sleuth! Although The Sleuth has been in the game for a few weeks now, we haven't formally introduced them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/56a4faaf968fe530924f0ef7b760797fd00704f1.png[/img]

The Sleuth has the power to investigate a pirate to see whether they have ever disobeyed at any point in the voyage so far. They won't know [b]when[/b] they disobeyed, but this is still a very useful ability! In order to investigate a pirate, The Sleuth must use up a lead. Leads are earned every day that there are at least two disobeys in a job - so the more ghosts you have, the more likely your Sleuth is to find leads!

Additionally, The Sleuth always starts the game with one lead, so even if the ghosts are being on their best behaviour, they might not be able to hide from The Sleuth for long!

[h2]New Event: Disagreement[/h2]
During a Disagreement event, two pirates from the centre of the ship have a falling out and decide to move away from each other. Each pirate will move as far away as they can, taking on the ranks of second-in-command and Cabin Boy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c2649852b64cfff54d418188c464dabb674bed24.png[/img]

[h2]New Event: Crew's Revenge[/h2]
During a Crew's Revenge event, the entire crew will have the opportunity to take revenge on the most bloodthirsty pirate. If you've successfully thrown the most pirates overboard, you might find yourself facing a very angry crew!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f9a9b9eee46bde9290366f408b1400bb8d13944f.png[/img]

The Crew's Revenge event works like the Mutiny event, so if more than half of the crew vote to take revenge, the bloodthirstiest pirate will get thrown overboard. If they were a human, then any of the pirates that agreed to get revenge could become a ghost!

As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm GMT on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/IterationGames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/IterationGames]YouTube channel[/url] to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a9061627fa02d98b144147b96d32307494593ccf.png[/img]

When the entire crew have finished voting, but no pirate has gone overboard, The Magician will have the opportunity to cast a [b]magic vote[/b]. This magic vote has [b]three[/b] voting power, and can be cast for any pirate (other than The Magician themselves). The crew won't know who The Magician is, unless they can figure it out through deductive reasoning!

The magic vote still counts as voting for a pirate to go overboard, so if The Magician throws a human overboard they run the risk of becoming a ghost. Question is... who are they?

[h2]The “Let Them Eat Cake” Event![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during The Big Birthday Bash, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the “Let Them Eat Cake” event. The crew will divide up a huge birthday cake, taking the chance to blow out the candles one by one. It's believed that the last person who blows out a candle will get to make a wish... what will they wish for, and will their wish come true?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/70386c31bd463a3527c88c36361f472849847835.png[/img]

[h2]Birthday Gift Bounties[/h2]
Every day during The Big Birthday Bash the crew will receive a special birthday gift bounty! If you complete the assigned task, you can open a present, and inside you will find... a special cosmetic surprise! There are [b]twelve[/b] different cosmetics in total to collect, so make sure to collect your birthday gifts during the seasonal celebration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ed9bb22657a8d38b33dc0e2b542b85026d44b260.png[/img]

[h2]Limited Time Costumes and Ship Parts[/h2]
During The Big Birthday Bash, Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop ship! If you buy a customisation option during The Big Birthday Bash, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/231eb795f229c2e36e4be1b9680fb5405a11e1ad.png[/img]

The full list of outfit items available during The Big Birthday Bash is:

[*] Jackets - Waistcoat (Magician)

Invite bots into your game during The Big Birthday Bash, and you may find some of the regular crew replaced with one or three bots that mimic the Iteration Games crew! They’ll only join your games during The Big Birthday Bash, but these bots have their own personality and appearances modelled after the Paper Pirates developers.

notes.title: It's the Steam Mystery Fest...
notes.notes:
[h1]There's a thief in our midst![/h1]
It's time for the Steam Mystery Fest celebration, and it seems the Paper Pirates crew have a mystery of their very own to solve. Someone's swiped all the treasure, and we don't know who! Not to panic though, The Captain has been in touch with world-famous detective, Tabotha Tabs, and she's accepted the challenge of coming aboard and figuring out exactly whodunnit. The Steam Mystery Fest runs from Monday 20th - Monday 27th February, so we need to solve the mystery before it ends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b9189a1165560655470038530df7e49341d12d10.png[/img]

[h2]There's a mystery to be solved![/h2]
Set sail every day during the Steam Mystery Fest, and you'll find a clue. These clues will surely help you to track down the guilty party. Not only that, if all the Paper Pirate crews on the seven seas work together, there's bound to be a special reward for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/07d5cc11c60c80d4c64f808277914a25fe5927e9.png[/img]

[h2]Huge Paper Pirates discount![/h2]
During the Mystery Fest, we want everyone to get involved in finding clues and solving the mystery. If you've had your eye on Paper Pirates for a while, or you've got friends looking to jump aboard, you'll be able to pick the game up for 75% off during the entire celebration!

notes.title: Valentine Voyages!
notes.notes:
[h1]Find romance on the seven seas with Valentine Voyages![/h1]
This February, we’re again celebrating with the Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, Valentine Voyages! Running from[b] 7th February - 21st February[/b], celebrate the season of love with a festival of romance, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4de8e25ba620b8c981981aa8834e09a68af2fd10.png[/img]

[h2]Love Letter Bounties[/h2]
What's this? The crew has received a mysterious letter, emblazoned with a heart motif? What could this mysterious love letter mean? It seems that there's a series of tasks for you to complete throughout Valentine Voyage's, and each one rewards you with... a special heart-shaped box!? What could be inside?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/afb4e4ad3c9058162e13886c255b3ad0bc525a68.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Admirer[/h2]
During Valentine Voyages, you may encounter the seasonal trait, The Admirer! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4299cea4e4dd5b33fe9c580bf9f4f2a506abc089.png[/img]

During the first day, The Admirer must choose a target of their admiration from the crew. The Admirer's team will then immediately change to match the pirate they chose. Not only that, but every time The Admirer's target changes team, The Admirer's team will change too! That means if the target of their admiration becomes a ghost... Well, you know what you have to do!

The Admirer's team will no longer change through other means (if they're a human, they can't join the ghost team unless their target pirate is haunted), so watch out for any very tricky Admirer plays!

[h2]Limited Time Costumes and Ship Parts[/h2]
During Valentine Voyages, Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop ship! If you buy a customisation option during Valentine Voyages, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ade404eb0ec6218c91afe44e536d3a89f03a6b58.png[/img]

[h2]The “Cupid’s Arrow” Event![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Valentine Voyages, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the “Cupid’s Arrow” event. A random member of the crew is given the opportunity to fire Cupid’s arrow at another. Whoever they fire it at will have their role changed to match the person who fired the arrow - whether they were human, or ghost! Keep track of the arrow, and see if you can deduce whose role is what as you forge ahead on your voyage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b5bb60309c1582d7a85bbf0a10cd09bd0acffbc9.png[/img]

[h2]The "Love Letter" Event![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Valentine Voyage, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the "Love Letter" event. A randomly chosen pirate must commit to sending a love letter to a pirate of their choice. What secrets will this letter reveal? The pirate may choose to either share their team, or their trait, with their lover. What information will they reveal, and more importantly, why did they choose to share that particular piece of information?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4c4bdc478d1e6fe926350bf900ed104438761d2d.png[/img]

[h2]Valentine Celebrations in the Photo Booth[/h2]
To celebrate Valentine Voyages, there is a limited-time Foil available in the Photo Booth, in the Captain’s Log. Take the opportunity to snap your favourite pirate templates, and share any pics you take! 

Invite bots into your game during Valentine Voyages, and you may find some of the regular crew replaced with one or two super romantic guests, out to help you find love at sea! They’ll only join your games during Valentine Voyages, but these bots have their own personality and appearances for you to enjoy.

notes.title: Soggy Hogmanay!
notes.notes:
Throughout January, we’re celebrating with the Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Soggy Hogmanay[/b]! Running from 1st January - 21st January, celebrate the start of the New Year with a festival of glad tidings, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ae63053a43fe6452a0bbbe678f4825f4d5e7cdff.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: [b]The Resolute[/b][/h2]
Returning to Soggy Hogmanay is the seasonal trait, The Resolute! Play a trait game during Soggy Hogmanay, and one of the crew may find themselves playing as The Resolute.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fdaf53c3d4ac756366c182f624ab5e41dde8d751.png[/img]

The Resolute must make a New Year's Resolution during the first day of the voyage. Their resolution asks them to pledge their allegiance to either the human or the ghost team. Whichever team they pick, they will instantly join - and they won't be able to become a member of the opposite team, no matter what happens, for the entirety of the remainder of the voyage!

Their choice is private to them, so make sure you don't get caught out by a sneaky Resolute pretending to have become a perma-human, when they might actually have just become The Tainted's best friend...

[h2]Resolution Bounty[/h2]
Rumour has spread of a mysterious monster at sea... what could it be? Is it even real? During Soggy Hogmanay, if you scour the seven seas enough, you might catch a glimpse of a very special creature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c04c4ec233441e16bcf3d5a8a6b2b05fee0bddfa.png[/img]

Check your bounty board after every voyage, because your time spent at sea might unveil a very special reward for you and your crew. You only have until the end of Soggy Hogmanay to complete the bounty, so make sure you make a new year's resolution to spend more time sailing than ever before!

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]
During Soggy Hogmanay, Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Soggy Hogmanay, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/2162442bc5110ddde06248157a41a102a009e8ae.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Event: [b]The Fastest First Foot[/b][/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Soggy Hogmanay, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the ‘Fastest First Foot’ event, inspired by the Hogmanay tradition of First Footing. As the crew return from an adventure on a deserted treasure island, they race to see who has the honour of first footing the pirate ship. Those pirates who make it back first are granted good fortune for the coming voyage - and will be given a higher rank on the ship accordingly! Have your devices at the ready and press a button as soon as it appears, and any pirate has the chance of seizing the rank of captain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/0d8256140440003a8e0f1d1573638dd749c87c30.png[/img]

[h2]Hogmanay Celebrations in the Photo Booth[/h2]

They’ll only join your games during Soggy Hogmanay, but these bots have their own personalities and appearances for you to enjoy.

notes.title: Yules Tides Community Bounty & Happy Hannukah!
notes.notes:
[h1]Yule Tides Community Bounty - Complete![/h1]
A huge congratulations to all Paper Pirates' crew for completing the Yule Tides community bounty! For collectively playing 125 games, all pirates can claim a full Penguin outfit - to keep and use all year round! The penguin utilises your primary colour, and even comes with a big bow tie to look extra dapper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/55295c91c4b4375dbbd56a0f578aa170d432c45c.png[/img]

There are only 14 days to claim the Penguin outfit, so make sure you open up Paper Pirates today and claim the bounty before it disappears forever!

[h1]Happy Hannukah![/h1]
Happy Hanukkah to all pirates celebrating as they sail the seas of Paper Pirates! For the duration of Hanukkah, pirates can wear the Menorah Hat. Each real life day, a new candle will be added and lit, so the hat's appearance will evolve over the course of the festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4abf4f3feedcf1b30e7b3a5687f104713cbd7ce5.png[/img]

We hope all pirates, whichever festivities they celebrate, have a wonderful festive period and remember to stay safe while sailing the seven seas!

notes.title: Yule Tides!
notes.notes:
[h2]Prepare for Merriment and Mischief on the Yule Tides![/h2]
Throughout all of December, we’re celebrating, sharing, and gift giving, with the fourth Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, Yule Tides! Running from 1st December - 31st December, celebrate Christmas with a festival of merriment and joy, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ce7d805bff1f386e8111f2c09c94c1b41d822635.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Gift Giver[/h2]
Returning to Yule Tides for 2022 is the seasonal trait, The Gift Giver! Play a trait game during Yule Tides and one of the pirates may find themselves playing as The Gift Giver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7929060f5af8c6cb0856a185b84d06130c95533e.png[/img]

The Gift Giver is offered a present to gift to a pirate of their choice on every day when they don't play in. There are a range of different gifts, but which one you get to give is random each day! You can only give three gifts on each voyage - and to make things even more tricky, each pirate can only receive a gift once.

Will you get the gifts you need to sail to success? Or will you accidentally end up giving away a victory to the ghosts.

[h2]Advent Bounties[/h2]
During the Christmas season, the bounty board is celebrating each and every day that passes! Each day throughout December, you’ll receive a special Advent Bounty, with a challenge for you to complete! If you complete an advent bounty, you'll be rewarded with a special Paper Pirates Present! There are [b]eleven[/b] items for you to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9157c2f873325f7c5cc3a45c5361bab923c99bc6.png[/img]

The advent bounties are time-limited, so you have to complete them on the day you get them - but don’t worry if you don’t, there’ll be a new one waiting for you tomorrow!

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]
During Yule Tides, Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Yule Tides, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b944860d45972c0029b60417385dbeee90998b27.png[/img]

The full list of Ship Shop items available during Yule Tides is:

Additionally, during Yule Tides, pirates will be able to wear a host of unique hats - there are [b]five[/b] seasonal hats available to everyone in voyages started during the event.  Once the event’s over, the hats will disappear from your collection until next year, so be sure to wear them while you can!

[h2]Cracking Crackers[/h2]
While sailing on the even seas during Yule Tides, you might find the crew getting a little rowdy with all the partying and merriment! Encounter the Cracking Crackers event, and two members of your crew will decide to pull a giant size festive cracker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9bdae9e3c239ee0e1156d6724abbd3f1df7400eb.png[/img]

Hit the button on your device more times than your opponent to claim the bigger half of the cracker - and save yourself from certain doom, as the loser will be flung overboard from the force of the cracker's explosion! Watch out though, if the losing pirate was a human, the one walking away with the bigger piece will now be a ghost...

[h2]Snowball Fight![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Yule Tides, and each day there is a chance it may begin to snow giving the crew the opportunity to partake in a little festive fun - a traditional snowball fight! When Snowball Fight is triggered, each member of the crew must choose who to pelt with a snowball. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/24388077cf067ade639f06b6876e6bbec1727222.png[/img]

The pirate who receives the most snowballs will be thrown overboard! Who will you throw your snowball at? When they go overboard, if they’re a human, one of the people who threw the snowball will become a ghost… so choose wisely!

[h2]Naughty or Nice?[/h2]
During your Yule Tides sailing adventures, you may encounter the ‘Naughty or Nice’ event during the event phase of the game. In ‘Naughty or Nice’, one member of the crew must offer a gift to another. Question is - has the receiver been naughty, or nice? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a791b387abde0a64441d7f63daa58776158a55af.png[/img]

The present-giver must decide, with a host of fun positive outcomes for nice, and some meaner tricks for naughty. When the receiver is given the gift, they can choose whether to open it, or discard it. Do you think your crewmate has sent you something nice, or are they a ghost, hoping to catch you out? That’s all part of festive deception!

[h2]Yule Tidings come to the Photo Booth[/h2]
To celebrate the season, there are a small number of limited-time Foils and Backgrounds available in the Photo Booth, in the Captain’s Log. Take the opportunity to snap your favourite pirate templates with a little festive frivolity, and don’t forget to share any pics you take! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/98e048142b81c885db30524f3a4cd52800cb4c3b.png[/img]

[h2]Yule Tides Bots[/h2]
Invite some bots into your game during Yule Tides, and you may find some of the regular crew replaced with some particularly festive bots, out to celebrate Christmas! They’ll only join your games during Yule Tides, but each has their own personality and appearance for you to enjoy.

notes.title: The Festive Feast!
notes.notes:
[h2]What are you thankful for during the Festive Feast Event?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/486b22700b2487a0e95890a90c2acf3fe46c2721.png[/img]

Through the second half of November, we’re taking some time to be thankful in our most delicious seasonal event, The Festive Feast! Running from 16th November - 30th November, celebrate the harvest season with a festival of feasting and thankfulness and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Quarterback[/h2]
Our new seasonal trait for The Festive Feast is [b]The Quarterback[/b]! The Quarterback is gifted with an exploding football, and knows exactly how many days the football will take to explode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5590d9f073908136bbc1b337f5ceac6074a2a4e6.png[/img]

They may pass the ball to any other pirate, who then has the chance to either pass it on to another pirate or keep hold of it in the pre-event phase of the next day. The Quarterback will always know exactly how many days there are until the football explodes, throwing the pirate currently holding it overboard. Can you trust The Quarterback's timings, or will you find yourself blown up by their lies?

[h2]Make a Wish Every Day[/h2]
Play Paper Pirates during The Festive Feast and you can make a festive wish once per day! Play at least one game, and after your voyage you'll receive a gift from the bounty board!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b58b98a0ba216c90b460848e704d94a91e1d0b70.png[/img]

There are five American football-themed outfit pieces for you to collect from the daily quests, so make sure to play a game of Paper Pirates on five different days before the celebration ends on the 30th November!

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/aa9aa07e451e82891bc9ab0cf98de2afd09589c1.png[/img]

During The Festive Feast, Sam Sherbot and Nat O’Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Festive Feast, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today!

[h2]Wish on a Wishbone![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/82e474b9c59a73fb0fbd38a9a4a2cc3d68e4814b.png[/img]

Go on a sailing adventure during The Festive Feast, and your crew will have the chance to partake in the time-honoured ritual of wishing on a wishbone. During the Event phase of the game, the Wish on a Wishbone event may activate for the duration of The Festive Feast, offering two randomly chosen pirates the opportunity to wish for an event to occur. Which of the pirates will pull the larger half of the wishbone and have their wishes granted…? That’s all part of the fun of Wish on a Wishbone!

[h2]Festive Feast Bots[/h2]
Invite some bots into your game during The Festive Feast, and you may find some of the regular crew replaced with some particularly festive bots, out to celebrate Thanksgiving! They’ll only join your games during The Festive Feast, but each has their own personality and appearance for you to enjoy.

notes.title: Día de Muertos - Day of the Dead Event!
notes.notes:
[h1]Honour the Spirits of the Dead during Día de Muertos![/h1]
Through early November, we’re honouring the spirits of the dead with our most spiritual seasonal event, Día de Muertos running from 1st November - 14th November!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/84ffd5bfcc24347b5ce0beccfb0781e7541ebbc3.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Spiritualist[/h2]
Our new seasonal trait for Día de Muertos is [b]The Spiritualist[/b]. On days when The Spiritualist does not play in, they may decorate a sugar skull offering using any pattern of their choice.

notes.title: Berserker Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Channel your rage as The Berseker![/h1]
Jump aboard Paper Pirates to explore the Berserker Update, featuring a new trait and some QoL improvements throughout!

[h2]New Trait: The Berserker[/h2]
Our new trait for the Berserker Update is [b]The Berserker[/b]!

The Berserker is the master of channelling their rage, but sometimes they just just have to let it all out! Each time The Berserker passes their vote, they will gain an additional one voting power. This keeps increasing each time they pass their vote! When they unleash their rage, their bonus voting power reduces to zero, and it can be built up again.

But beware, lest you be overcome by your rage! If The Berserker's normal voting power plus their bonus voting power is greater than or equal to the vote threshold, they will lose their ability to pass their vote. This means they must throw someone overboard - no questions asked!

Make sure that you manage your rage carefully, lest you accidentally end up throwing a human overboard all on your own and becoming a ghost...

[h2]More Animated Votes[/h2]
We've given the black spots used during a voting a little bit more energy! They've now got a nice animation that makes it clearer how many votes a pirate is casting, and also includes a better visual display of how many votes each pirate cast should a pirate go overboard.

It now feels much more exciting to vote for someone, but be careful who you vote for because you might be making more ghosts on the ship!

[h2]Outfit Shop Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
Sam Sherbot is always hard at work to help make shopping at the Outfit Shop a dream. They've introduced two new features to help you browse, try on and shop with maximum comfort!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/d1e7db69ab37aa1cb5b68d6afc81e7acd13e7268.png[/img]

[h3]Buy Whole Sets[/h3]
Complimenting the Buy Whole Outfit button added in 3.5, Sam now advertises whole sets for sale. This might be all the parts to dress up as your favourite animal, or many other costumes where different outfit parts just all work together! Pick a whole outfit, and buy all the pieces in one go using the Buy Whole Outfit button. Spending your hard earn coins has never been so easy!

[h3]Try on Hats[/h3]
Sometimes, to complete the perfect outfit, you need the perfect hat. Sam's giving you the opportunity to browse your hat collection, and you can now try on hats in the Outfit Shop! You have to have unlocked a hat for it to appear in the list, but once you do, you can try it on with all the other outfit parts. It'll also be added to your outfit code, so you can dress a pirate up completely without ever even opening the lobby!

As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/IterationGames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/IterationGames]YouTube channel[/url] to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3RDkuJ58Xb]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Protection and Peril Update
notes.notes:
[h1]It's Perilous on the High Seas![/h1]
Jump aboard Paper Pirates to explore the Protection and Peril Update, full of new features to spice up your voyages!

[h2]New Trait: The Reaper[/h2]
Our first new trait for the Protection and Peril Update is [b]The Reaper[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/df0ab8f90c3a803cf2e84d2afe884eda3f5fa01e.png[/img]

Whenever any other pirate goes overboard, The Reaper harvests a soul, collecting them for nefarious deeds. When The Reaper does not play in, they can spend the souls they've harvested to form one of several pacts, influencing the game in a powerful way.

Each voyage, the four pacts The Reaper can enact are chosen randomly, so it's never quite the same twice in a row! Will you use the power of The Reaper for good, or for evil?

[h2]New Trait: The Protector[/h2]
Our second new trait for the Protection and Peril Update is [b]The Protector[/b]!

During Day One, The Protector must choose any other pirate to protect. No matter how many votes the protected pirate receives during voting, they will not be thrown overboard. The pirate they choose to protect is a secret until the point at which they would have gone overboard, when the pirate will display a shield and become immune to further votes that round!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/635a632f8936b47acffd6bd35492d0c027e03e7d.png[/img]

On days when they don't play in, The Protector may choose to change which pirate they're protecting. Who will The Protector choose to protect, and will they make sure they change their mind in time?

[h2]Empowering the Audience![/h2]
Alongside the new traits, we're giving the audience more power! We've added over ten new events, which will only appear when you have an audience watching your game. Each event allows the audience to influence the game in some important way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f41ac68771e50c854b641145eb1926122885257e.png[/img]

When the audience is empowered, they can do things like choose a new captain, turn someone into a ghost, swap two pirate's teams, and much more. Who's watching your game? Do you trust them to help the humans, or are they sneaky ghosties?

You can customise how often an empowered audience event happens in your games, including turning them off completely, in the custom game menu under the Events tab.

[h2]Two New Events: Disarray & Equality[/h2]
We're welcoming two new regular events to Paper Pirates - Disarray and Equality. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4a7f96a5e00a3b6c436a13489590864c5b496797.png[/img]

When the Disarray event happens, the crew become disoriented and confused, and an ongoing effect triggers which shuffles the order of voting randomly each day! This can really mess with the natural order of voting, so watch carefully who votes first!

When the Equality event happens, the crew commit to equality for all pirates. In terms of voting, this means that all pirates will have the same number of votes! This empowers the stowaway, and weakens the Captain, and can easily change up who votes for who.

Both Disarray and Equality last from when the event triggers until the next time a pirate is voted overboard.

[h2]Shop Enhancements[/h2]
Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have invested in some upgrades for their shops, and added some new features and functionality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a6594e710da44f6b075f61c2a29cda16a8b7299b.png[/img]

The Outfit Shop has been upgraded with the following new features:
[list]
[*] Categories with newly added items now have a 'new' label, and individual items in categories will also tell you that they've recently been added to the shop.
[*] More accurately customise the model in the shop, including options to try on different left and right hands and feet.
[*] Create outfits in the Outfit Shop, and copy the Outfit Code directly from the shop ready for use in the in-game lobby! This also means you can create Outfit Codes using items you haven't bought yourself yet.
[*] Once you've finished dressing up the pirate model in the Outfit Shop, there's a new option to buy all the items you don't own in one go. Customise a whole look, and buy it in one fell swoop for the ultimate convenient shopping experience!
[/list]
The Ship Shop has been upgraded, and Nat O'Bother will now offer regular sales on their ship parts. The items on sale change once every week, so if you see something on sale that you can't quite afford, there's still time to save up and buy, buy, buy!

[h2]More Customisation Options![/h2]
Sam Sherbot has been sailing far and wide to bring you the latest pirate fashions! Become a wolf or an elephant, turn your pirate into an orc, and more with a new range of outfit shop items available for purchase!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a1b380245e7350ce89eee07176df4aac872be9c4.png[/img]

As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/IterationGames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/IterationGames]YouTube channel[/url] to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3RDkuJ58Xb]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Oktoberfest on the Ocean!
notes.notes:
[h2]Grab a sausage and celebrate Oktoberfest![/h2]
As we see out September, we’re celebrating the ninth Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Oktoberfest on the Ocean![/b] Running from 18th to 30th September, celebrate the end of the season with a shindig dedicated to pretzels, sausages, chicken dancing and more, with a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9725aeae9559a1d9301861d0ae10159c236573be.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Brewmaster[/h2]
The Brewmaster is here, and they're ready to get the party started! When you have a Brewmaster aboard, they'll be asked to set the vibe of the ship during the first day. Whichever vibe they choose will mix up the Paper Pirates voting rules!

There are a total of four vibes The Brewmaster can pick for the ship:
[list]
[*] [b]Aggressive Vibes[/b] - Grants each pirate one additional voting power
[*] [b]Chaotic Vibes[/b] - Instead of voting from Stowaway to Captain, the crew will vote in a randomised order each day
[*] [b]Determined Vibes[/b] - Removes the crew's ability to pass their vote
[*] [b]Energetic Vibes[/b] - If nobody has gone overboard after the Captain has voted, a second round of voting begins. Votes from the previous round carry forward!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/99f1a2410f59672aa2f09aac190a735498f58869.png[/img]

Whichever vibe they pick will stay in effect for the rest of the voyage. However, each day The Brewmaster doesn't play in, they can choose to change up the vibe, and bring a new mood to the party. How will having The Brewmaster aboard change the way your crew votes people over?

[h2]Grab Limited Time Customisation Options[/h2]
During Oktoberfest on the Ocean, Sam Sherbot and Nat O’Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Oktoberfest on the Ocean, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/26786b6f51f449364f4301ee5837a7ad36a182f7.png[/img]

[h2]The “Biggest Bratwurst” Event![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Oktoberfest on the Ocean, and any day when there’s a successful job there is a chance you may encounter the “Biggest Bratwurst” event! The pirates stop for a cook-out, each grabbing a sausage from the grill. Some of the sausages are much bigger than the others though, and everyone knows a pirate needs a full stomach to carry out the most important duties on the ship. The bigger your meal, the higher your rank on the ship! So watch out, if you pull a chipolata, you might end up as Stowaway!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ff8d4eac1fae66e68861039450daa6e586b2f2c6.png[/img]

The Biggest Bratwurst event is sure to mix things up amongst the crew, changing who’s next to each other and therefore who’s playing in for different groups of jobs together. Not only that, but if you’re playing a trait game, you might want to be extra careful of who ends up next to The Sensitive!

[h2]Oktoberfest on the Ocean Bots[/h2]
Invite bots into your game during Oktoberfest on the Ocean, and you may encounter any of four unique bots! Look out for Chicken Bot, Hans Botmann, Ida Botmann and Bot Dog, all of whom are eager to board your ship and throw you overboard! These bots will only join your games during Oktoberfest on the Ocean, so take the chance to meet them now before they chicken dance away for the rest of the year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e78f035e3c994cc3c992058e53a5918b5b45419a.png[/img]

notes.title: Rise of the Kraken
notes.notes:
[h1]The Kraken Awakens![/h1]
You thought the Kraken wouldn't notice all the times you fished up a squid on the island, huh? Well you were wrong! The Kraken is angry and looking for revenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/33a4737597a7de862e6465e0816046fa5f537cde.png[/img]

[h2]The Kraken Rises[/h2]
The Kraken Rises is our second adventure event, and like The Island Adventure, it has a whole host of minigames and challenges for pirates to encounter! As the Kraken emerges from the sea, you'll have the chance to fight it in different ways, before confronting it for a final showdown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/77f4902c6a4019808e29bad6fe4266ea26202fe2.png[/img]

The Kraken has five weaknesses for you to exploit, and if you successfully wound the Kraken it'll be much weaker in the final battle. However, each weakness comes with good and bad things that can happen for the crew, so be careful and choose where to aim your harpoons wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/10c871795c0dfb02bd4d3018be04cbf5c0f7defe.png[/img]

Once you've had your shot at wounding the Kraken, it will bear down on the ship ready for a final battle. All of the crew need to work together to fight the Kraken off! And whether you're victorious, or suffer defeat at the tentacles of the Kraken, the effects of the battle will surely be felt for the next few days of your voyage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a8905b614a1e2e2028e377eae11a7431f59aeece.png[/img]

[h1]New Customisation Options![/h1]
Sam Sherbot has gotten themselves new items for sale in the Outfit Shop aboard the Shop Ship, amongst them are a full Kraken outfit and the brand new Pride collection!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/27165a7c85f3bc397f235ae7ffe2aca420c32bdc.png[/img]

Not wanting to be outdone, Nat O'Bother also has a few new pieces in the Ship Shop aboard the Shop Ship. Definitely check out the Rainbow Hull and Rainbow Generator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/d55c0f40841beb20ea5540b5dab086e3d26fbb77.png[/img]

[h1]New Achievements[/h1]
With the rising of the Kraken come new achievements, and as always, new hats. If you can achieve any of the following, you'll have some brand new pirate headwear to ensure you're definitely talk of the town!

[list]
[*] [b] Oceanographer[/b] - Explore all the different ways to wound the Kraken during the The Kraken Rises event
[*] [b] Feast for the Kraken[/b] - Hide the entire crew in the same place during the The Kraken's Beak event
[*] [b] Apple of my Eye[/b] - Successfully blind the Kraken in the The Kraken's Eye event without making any mistakes
[*] [b] Potion Explosion[/b] -  As The Witch, use a Potion of Overboarding to throw yourself overboard
[*] [b] Buzz Off[/b] - Encounter the Wasp Nest event twenty-five times
[/list]

[h1]Five new traits![/h1]
As the Kraken rises out of the ocean, so too do five new traits for the crew! As always, these traits can be assigned to humans or ghosts, so get ready for yer mateys to cause you a whole world of trouble!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ef38eb3948955c428edfb6fb69d68f2a296c5f7b.png[/img]

[h2]New Trait: The Contrarian[/h2]
The Contrarian is, for all intents and purposes, contrary. Whenever they would become a human, they instead become a ghost. Whenever they would become a ghost, they instead become a human! And yes, this includes when they go overboard - so they'll always arrive back on the ship as a ghost stowaway...

[h2]New Trait: The Bodyswapper[/h2]
On days when The Bodyswapper does not play in, they can choose any other pirate. During the pre-event phase, the Bodyswapper will trade teams with their selected pirate. It's freaky! Will the Bodyswapper try to swap with a human, or a ghost? Can you keep track of who's who?

[h2]New Trait: The Brawler[/h2]
On days when The Brawler does not play in, they can challenge any other pirate to a brawl. The brawl plays out in the pre-event phase, with the traditional pirate brawling technique of rock-paper-scissors. If The Brawler wins the brawl, they'll steal their opponent's rank on the ship!

[h2]New Trait: The Beast[/h2]
Each and every time The Beast goes overboard, whether that's through an event or voting, their voting power increases by two. It keeps going up every time they're thrown overboard too, so be careful! Throwing The Beast overboard too many times means they have some big voting power...

[h2]New Trait: The Medium[/h2]
On days when The Medium does not play in, they can write a hidden message that will be revealed only to the ghosts in the pre-event phase. Whether the Medium is a human or a ghost, what information will they reveal and how will they coordinate, or trick, the ghosts?

[h2]New Trait Icons[/h2]
To help pirates familiarise themselves with the different traits, we've also added a unique icon for each and every trait. You can check these out in the Captain's Log, or you can be surprised by each trait icon as you discover it in your black spot!

[h1]Pirate Booty![/h1]
Just because your game's over doesn't mean the fun is! Once all the humans and ghosts have been uncovered, you'll now have the chance to see the booty you've collected on your voyage. There are various ways that you can earn coins in-game, and the Booty Board will help you to better understand where your coins from. Additionally, we've made it slightly easier to earn coins across the game. More cool outfits for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/10487cd8817a3aa79d20c82ccfa65def41ff4b35.png[/img]

The Booty Board also awards three accolades to members of the crew. Who will be celebrating? It might be an opportunity to celebrate a pirate who captained the ship to victory, or someone who changed teams most frequently!

[h1]We're Going on an Adventure![/h1]
With the introduction of a second adventure event, we're also adding a new event that can pop up giving pirates the option to pick which adventure they want to go on. Every single member of the crew gets a say, and the destination is decided by The Wheel of Fate (The Compass of Fate's older sibling). Will you set sail for the island, or can you see the beastly Kraken on the horizon?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e4e0d6e732e16dd348900e7b208390b9e12bf730.png[/img]

[h1]Limiting Some Traits to Certain Crew Sizes[/h1]
To promote game balance, and to make sure that everyone has a fun time when playing Trait games, we've set player limits for a few of the traits. In most cases, this means that you need a certain number of pirates in a game before a trait will appear. You can see how big the crew needs to be on the game customisation screen, and once your game starts the Trait Guide on each player's device will remove any traits that didn't make it into the game.

[h1]Take Photos of your Ship[/h1]
When customising your ship at the Ship Shop, we've added a little camera button that gives you a nice full screen view of your ship with a fancy name placard. This is great way to share photos of your different ships, and show off all the cool things you've bought!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/2b74080fd631307c738080b43e36e08a85184a1d.png[/img]

[h1]Pre-event Information in the Captain's Log[/h1]
Pre-events are those events that happen before the main event. The little ones that come into play when you use an active trait for example. To help you keep track, we've added these to the Captain's Log - and most importantly - they're listed in the order they'll happen each day. Confused about whether The Witch or The Wishful gets to use their power first? The Captain's Log tells all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/028d6e869d90bd8f1d6cfa4a2fe0ee789317e8f1.png[/img]

[h1]Improved Event Information on your Device[/h1]
We've all done it. The event is The Spy. It's you. You choose someone. You forget to look whether they're human or ghost, and that information is lost to the seas. Not anymore! Information revealed during events will now be displayed in a pop-up, that won't go away until you're ready. If you close the popup by accident, or just need a recap, your game log will now keep a personalised history of any information revealed to you in events. Handy!

[h1]The Bots are Getting Smarter[/h1]
We've made some improvements when playing with bots in trait games, and in particular, we've taught them how to use a number of different traits. Bots could already activate the traits of The Wishful and The Diligent, but bots can now also activate The Witch, The Shapeshifter, The Brawler, The Meddler and The Bodyswapper!

[h2]A few other bits and pieces...[/h2]
[list]
[*] When visiting the Captain's Log to check out the bios for the various bots, we've added pronouns for each.
[*] When in the lobby, you can use the new 'Add Bot' button to add a bot directly to your lobby. Super useful if you're looking for a particular bot to join your game!
[/list]

As always, don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm BST on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/IterationGames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/IterationGames]YouTube channel[/url] to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3RDkuJ58Xb]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Spring Sailing!

[h2]Go Egg Hunting on the Seven Seas with Spring Sailing![/h2]
Across March and April, we’re celebrating with the Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Spring Sailing![/b] Running from 15th March - 12th April, celebrate the season of spring with a festival of eggs, bunnies, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

Joining Paper Pirates for the duration of Spring Sailing is the seasonal trait, The Spring Chicken! Play a trait game, and one of the crew may find themselves with this happy-go-lucky, seasonal appropriate trait.

Each day, when The Spring Chicken is not the Captain, they will spring forward one rank of the crew at the start of the event phase! This happens even if there's no other event taking place! What seems like a blessing may be a curse - watch out if you're a ghostly Spring Chicken and you're almost next to The Sensitive...

Every day during Spring Sailing the crew will be challenged to an Egg Hunt by our very own Rabbot! notes.title: Big Birthday Bash!
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy birthday, Paper Pirates![/h1]
It's Paper Pirates' second birthday, and we’re celebrating with a new Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, The Big Birthday Bash! Running from 28th February - 14th March, celebrate the anniversary of the game's launch with a festival of partying, and a whole host of anniversary goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a0ec834d9ccdd49ae685e176d527a1a133bbf7d2.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Magician[/h2]
Joining Paper Pirates for the duration of The Big Birthday Bash is the seasonal trait, The Magician! Play a trait game during The Big Birthday Bash, and one of the crew may find themselves playing as The Magician.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a9061627fa02d98b144147b96d32307494593ccf.png[/img]

When the entire crew have finished voting, but no pirate has gone overboard, The Magician will have the opportunity to cast a [b]magic vote[/b]. This magic vote has two voting power, and can be cast for any pirate (other than The Magician themselves). The crew won't know who The Magician is, unless they can figure it out through deductive reasoning!

The magic vote still counts as voting for a pirate to go overboard, so if The Magician throws a human overboard they run the risk of becoming a ghost. Question is... who are they?

[h2]The “Let Them Eat Cake” Event![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during The Big Birthday Bash, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the “Let Them Eat Cake” event. The crew will divide up a huge birthday cake, taking the chance to blow out the candles one by one. It's believed that the last person who blows out a candle will get to make a wish... what will they wish for, and will their wish come true?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/70386c31bd463a3527c88c36361f472849847835.png[/img]

[h2]Birthday Gift Bounties[/h2]
Every day during The Big Birthday Bash the crew will receive a special birthday gift bounty! If you complete the assigned task, you can open a present, and inside you will find... a special cosmetic surprise! There are [b]eight[/b] different cosmetics in total to collect, so make sure to collect your birthday gifts during the seasonal celebration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ed9bb22657a8d38b33dc0e2b542b85026d44b260.png[/img]

[h2]Limited Time Costumes and Ship Parts[/h2]

notes.title: Valentine Voyages!
notes.notes:
[h1]Find romance on the seven seas with Valentine Voyages![/h1]
This February, we’re celebrating with the Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, Valentine Voyages! Running from 7th February - 21st February, celebrate the season of love with a festival of romance, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4de8e25ba620b8c981981aa8834e09a68af2fd10.png[/img]

[h2]Reworked Trait: The Cursed[/h2]

We wanted to give a little extra oomph to playing as The Cursed, and at the same time make it so that the ghosts have a few more options when they're corned by a cunning spy. To give The Cursed more playstyles, we've added to their trait a permanent disguise; Whenever their team is revealed through traits or events, they'll always show as if they're a ghost even when they're human.

When playing a Trait Game, you might always want to think twice before throwing someone overboard... Are they really The Tainted or could they be The Cursed in disguise?!

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Admirer[/h2]
New to Valentine Voyages 2022 is the seasonal trait, The Admirer! Play a trait game during Valentine Voyages, and one of the crew may find themselves playing as The Admirer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4299cea4e4dd5b33fe9c580bf9f4f2a506abc089.png[/img]

In the first day, The Admirer must choose a target of their admiration from the crew. The Admirer's team will then immediately change to match the pirate they chose. Not only that, but every time The Admirer's target changes team, The Admirer's team will change too! That means if the target of their admiration becomes a ghost... Well, you know what you have to do!

The Admirer's team will no longer change through other means (if they're a human, they can't join the ghost team unless their target pirate is haunted), so watch out for any very tricky Admirer plays!

[h2]Limited Time Costumes and Ship Parts[/h2]
During Valentine Voyages, Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop ship! If you buy a customisation option during Valentine Voyages, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today!

Go on a sailing adventure during Valentine Voyages, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the “Cupid’s Arrow” event. A random member of the crew is given the opportunity to fire Cupid’s arrow at another. Whoever they fire it at will have their role changed to match the person who fired the arrow - whether they were human, or ghost! notes.title: Soggy Hogmanay!
notes.notes:
[h2]Ring in the New Year on the Seven Seas with Soggy Hogmanay![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ae63053a43fe6452a0bbbe678f4825f4d5e7cdff.png[/img]

Throughout January, we’re celebrating with the Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, [b]Soggy Hogmanay[/b]! Running from 1st January - 21st January, celebrate the start of the New Year with a festival of glad tidings, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[h2]Reworked Trait: The Diligent[/h2]

In preparation for the New Year, but staying all year round, is a revised version of The Diligent. We've moved The Diligent to an active trait but one that only activates when you are chosen to play in! When participating in a job, The Diligent will be asked - after choosing whether to obey or disobey - if they want to work a little harder. If they do, the outcome of the day's job will be doubled. That means if it's a success, the crew move two spaces to shore, but if it's a failure, two treasures will go overboard!

The newly revised Diligent also activates when you're the Captain, so be very careful of a Ghost Captain Diligent who might be making a mad rush to get all your treasure overboard at the last second!

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Resolute[/h2]
New to Soggy Hogmanay 2021 is the seasonal trait, The Resolute! Play a trait game during Soggy Hogmanay, and one of the crew may find themselves playing as The Resolute.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/fdaf53c3d4ac756366c182f624ab5e41dde8d751.png[/img]

The Resolute must make a New Year's Resolution during the first day of the voyage. Their resolution asks them to pledge their allegiance to either the human or the ghost team. Whichever team they pick, they will instantly join - and they won't be able to become a member of the opposite team, no matter what happens, for the entirety of the remainder of the voyage!

Their choice is private to them, so make sure you don't get caught out by a sneaky Resolute pretending to have become a perma-human, when they might actually have just become The Tainted's best friend...

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]
During Soggy Hogmanay, Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Soggy Hogmanay, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today!

[h2]The ‘Fastest First Foot’ Event![/h2]

Go on a sailing adventure during Soggy Hogmanay, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the ‘Fastest First Foot’ event, inspired by the Hogmanay tradition of First Footing. As the crew return from an adventure on a deserted treasure island, they race to see who has the honour of first footing the pirate ship. Those pirates who make it back first are granted good fortune for the coming voyage - and will be given a higher rank on the ship accordingly! Have your devices at the ready and press a button as soon as it appears, and any pirate has the chance of seizing the rank of captain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e831cfc8b0e177d7aea257fbb01c98d33741b69c.png[/img]

[h2]Resolution Bounty[/h2]
To help ring in the New Year, and start as you mean to go on, the bounty board is offering you a New Year’s Resolution Bounty! Throughout the duration of Soggy Hogmanay, you will have one giant bounty to complete! If you complete that one bounty over the course of the celebration, you will receive a truly staggering number of coins in celebration and you’ll be well on the way to a prosperous 2022. It’s just too good to miss!

[h2]Hogmanay Celebrations in the Photo Booth[/h2]
To celebrate the arrival of the new year, there are a small number of limited-time Foils and Backgrounds available in the Photo Booth, in the Captain’s Log. Take the opportunity to snap your favourite pirate templates, and share any pics you take!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/59bd49b447d6229954110902b701172d81a430c6.png[/img]

[h2]Soggy Hogmanay Bots[/h2]
Invite bots into your game during Soggy Hogmanay, and you may find some of the regular crew replaced with special New Year’s revellers, out to help you ring in the new year! They’ll only join your games during Soggy Hogmanay, but these bots have their own personalities and appearances for you to enjoy.

notes.title: Yule Tides!
notes.notes:
[h2]Prepare for Merriment and Mischief on the Yule Tides![/h2]
Throughout all of December, we’re celebrating, sharing, and gift giving, with the fourth Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, Yule Tides! Running from 1st December - 31st December, celebrate Christmas with a festival of merriment and joy, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ce7d805bff1f386e8111f2c09c94c1b41d822635.png[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Trait: The Gift Giver[/h2]
New to Yule Tides 2021 is the seasonal trait, The Gift Giver! Play a trait game during Haunted Seas, and one of the pirates may find themselves playing as The Gift Giver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7929060f5af8c6cb0856a185b84d06130c95533e.png[/img]

The Gift Giver is offered a present to gift to a pirate of their choice on every day when they don't play in. There are a range of different gifts, but which one you get to give is random each day! You can only give three gifts on each voyage - and to make things even more tricky, each pirate can only receive a gift once.

Will you get the gifts you need to sail to success? Or will you accidentally end up giving away a victory to the ghosts.

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]
During Yule Tides, Sam Sherbot and Nat O'Bother have some new customisation options available to unlock in the Shop Ship! If you buy a customisation option during Yule Tides, you can use it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/209d8fc9082c2fd97d409683a21ea2b3fb195bfd.png[/img]

The full list of Ship Shop items available during Yule Tides is:

Outfit Shop
[list]
[*] Face - Elf Ears
[*] Face - Snowman (Head)
[*] Facial Hair - Santa’s Beard
[*] Headwear - Scarf (Long)
[*] Headwear - Scarf (Short)
[*] Headwear - Hairpin (Holly)
[*] Shirt - Elf Tunic
[*] Shirt - Snowman (Upper)
[*] Shirt - Sweater (Reindeer)
[*] Shirt - Sweater (Robin)
[*] Shirt - Christmas Tree Top
[*] Coat - Santa’s Coat
[*] Legs - Elf Tights
[*] Legs - Snowman (Lower)
[*] Legs - Christmas Tree Skirt
[*] Feet - Elf Shoes
[/list]

Ship Shop
