[*] Masts - Christmas Mast II
[*] Masts - Christmas Mast III
[*] Masts - Christmas Tree
[*] Hulls - Christmas Hull
[*] Extras - Presents
[/list]

Additionally, during Yule Tides, pirates will be able to wear a host of unique hats - there are [b]five[/b] seasonal hats available to everyone in voyages started during the event.  Once the event’s over, the hats will disappear from your collection until next year, so be sure to wear them while you can!

[h2]Snowball Fight![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Yule Tides, and each day there is a chance it may begin to snow giving the crew the opportunity to partake in a little festive fun - a traditional snowball fight! When Snowball Fight is triggered, each member of the crew must choose who to pelt with a snowball. The pirate who receives the most snowballs will be thrown overboard! Who will you throw your snowball at? When they go overboard, if they’re a human, one of the people who threw the snowball will become a ghost… so choose wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7a1accfd0ad4a312a2e742cb941d8e0544603f6a.png[/img]

[h2]Naughty or Nice?[/h2]
During your Yule Tides sailing adventures, you may encounter the ‘Naughty or Nice’ event during the event phase of the game. In ‘Naughty or Nice’, one member of the crew must offer a gift to another. Question is - has the receiver been naughty, or nice? The present-giver must decide, with a host of fun positive outcomes for nice, and some meaner tricks for naughty. When the receiver is given the gift, they can choose whether to open it, or discard it. Do you think your crewmate has sent you something nice, or are they a ghost, hoping to catch you out? That’s all part of festive deception!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ca1dc1444cf2c895d27eda046215a7b98511ab45.png[/img]

[h2]Advent Bounties[/h2]
In the countdown to Christmas, the bounty board is celebrating each and every day that passes! Each day from the 1st-24th December, you’ll receive a special Advent Bounty, with a challenge for you to complete! If you complete an advent bounty, you'll be rewarded with a special Paper Pirates Present! There are [b]five[/b] Yeti-tastic items for you to discover!

The advent bounties are time-limited, so you have to complete them on the day you get them - but don’t worry if you don’t, there’ll be a new one waiting for you tomorrow!

[h2]Yule Tidings come to the Photo Booth[/h2]
To celebrate the season, there are a small number of limited-time Foils and Backgrounds available in the Photo Booth, in the Captain’s Log. Take the opportunity to snap your favourite pirate templates with a little festive frivolity, and don’t forget to share any pics you take! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/98e048142b81c885db30524f3a4cd52800cb4c3b.png[/img]

[h2]Yule Tides Bots[/h2]
Invite some bots into your game during Yule Tides, and you may find some of the regular crew replaced with some particularly festive bots, out to celebrate Christmas! They’ll only join your games during Yule Tides, but each has their own personality and appearance for you to enjoy.

notes.title: Meddlesome Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Trait: The Meddler[/h2]
Our first new trait for The Meddlesome Update is [b]The Meddler[/b]!

On days when The Meddler does not play in, they may choose a pirate that is playing in and change whatever they’ve chosen to play in today to either an obey or a disobey. Like other active traits, their power is limited and The Meddler can only meddle a maximum of three times each voyage.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9306175911869a17416e809e272599e15b1b5609.png[/img]

When a meddle takes place, the pirate whose job was meddled will receive a private prompt on their device to let them know that they’ve been meddled (and whether their choice is being forced to obey or disobey), and just before the job cards are revealed on the main screen you will see an indication that a meddle took place today.

Whether your Meddler is a ghost trying to meticulously frame a human pirate, or a human pirate thwarting the plans of your ghosts, The Meddler is sure to add an extra layer to all your social deducting.

[h2]New Trait: The Sensitive[/h2]
Our second new trait for The Meddlesome Update is [b]The Sensitive[/b]!

The Sensitive is able to tell, by checking their black spot, whether they are currently next to a ghost on the ship. That means if the pirate one rank up, or down, from them is a ghost - or even if both are! - The Sensitive will know that they’re near some spooky business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/695b810021d2b3e88c2dae25248f1ce1e91a1836.png[/img]

The Sensitive adds a whole new perspective to events which change pirate’s rank and positions on the ship. Watch out when the captain promotes you - they might be bringing you into the suspicion of The Sensitive!

[h2]New Feature: The Ship Shop[/h2]
Nat O’Bother has opened up his Ship Shop - a new expansion to the Shop Ship! Bobbing in his barrel, but always ready to go, nothing is too much bother for our Nat!

The Ship Shop’s specialism is helping you to customise your ship - as displayed on the title screen and sailing while you’re on a voyage. Everyone gets a free ship slot by default, so you can visit Nat and start building right away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8bd93184be18d30dfbdef36c3a9fdc55b202f180.png[/img]

Nat sells a wide range of ship parts for PP Coins, from figureheads to flags, from sails to sterns, and you can combine them to build the ship of your dreams. To top things off, he’s also here to help you give each ship a name and icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/0727589791b30ddb1bb6c08f64888d90016c5d5f.png[/img]

If you’re feeling flush and customisation’s your thing, Nat can also sell you additional ship slots which let you own more than one ship - saving custom ship configurations to switch between quickly. The more ships you own, the more they cost, so having a navy of seaworthy ships might take more adventurin’ than you expect!

[h2]New Event: Ominous Winds[/h2]
With The Meddlesome Update, we’re also introducing one new event - [b]Ominous Winds[/b]! When Ominous Winds blow, a pirate is sure to see an omen of the future. What will this omen do? Will it threaten to throw a pirate overboard? Offer them a promotion to captain? Or something else entirely?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4408e502c08a72121691ccdd216d2235ac3694d3.png[/img]

All omens are tracked as ongoing events (so you can see the details at the side of the screen!) and grant a sense of impending fortune or doom to a particular pirate. Will your omen play out, or will it expire before it has a chance to take effect?

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
We’ve made some improvements to the Paper Pirates UI to increase readability, and to help add understanding to the way the game is played. The following three key features are designed with new players in mind in particular:

[h3]The Phase Tracker[/h3]
In the top left of the game screen, you’ll now see the phase tracker. The phase tracker indicates which stage (playing in, event or voting) of the current day you’re at, and which one is coming up next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a3091ff46357f8dc9769c58ba52bf924978134f7.png[/img]

[h3]Device Action Reminders[/h3]
We’ve made it more clear when someone needs to take an action on their device, with a clearer indicator above a pirate. These trigger when a pirate needs to make a choice in an event or vote a pirate overboard for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/3296d0f251f1cbbaea3c7203b733542c5c98dd17.png[/img]

[h3]‘Who Voted?’ Indicators[/h3]
In addition to the existing ‘Who voted for who’ tracker on each player’s device, we’ve added a visual indicator of who cast votes for who during voting in the form of coloured black spots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ecb3195dcc89c05181376cc9da6a406dcb15b70f.png[/img]

[h3]‘Can Create a Ghost’ Indicator[/h3]
When an event has an action or decision that might create a ghost, the event message box will give you a little warning to let you know. Look out for this as a helpful reminder when weighing up whether it’s worthwhile to poison that soup or not!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/947f287a58fcb53774bc425986f7e70c3e5e043a.png[/img]

notes.title: Deduction and Deception Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Trait: The Shapeshifter![/h2]
It’s great to see so many people having fun with Trait games, and the popularity of The Wishful hasn’t gone unnoticed. We’re super excited to introduce some additional new traits in 3.2, which share The Wishful’s playful sense of having a power they can activate on days when they don’t play in.  Our first new trait in 3.2 is: [b]The Shapeshifter[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/10bf6a9bae5f2bbe32b36043d4b768e98b59d063.png[/img]

On days when The Shapeshifter does not play in, they may shift their shape, swapping their team (from human team to ghost team, or from ghost team to human team).  Like The Wishful, their power is limited and The Shapeshifter can only change their shape three times each voyage.  

The big limiting factor on The Shapeshifter is only being able to use their power when they don’t play in. Will you take the opportunity to shift your team early in the game, hoping things play out as you expect, or risk a later game switch and risk playing in every day and ending up trapped on the losing team?

[h2]New Trait: The Interrogator![/h2]
Our second new trait in 3.2 is: [b]The Interrogator[/b]!

On days when The Interrogator does not play in, they may prepare an interrogation by choosing a pirate and a specific trait.  They will then be told whether their interrogation was correct or incorrect through their trait information in the black spot.  Like The Wishful and The Shapeshifter, their power is limited and The Interrogator can only prepare three interrogations each voyage.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/cdd1beb2297f38f760d9424d66b22598a7ef0635.png[/img]

As with most traits, The Interrogator can begin the game on either the Human team or the Ghost team, so you never know whether your Interrogator is working for good or for evil. Even if they’ve managed to uncover some juicy information, can you always trust what they want to share with the crew?

[h2]Reworked Trait: The Disguised![/h2]
We love The Disguised, and we know that you do too, but one of the things we’ve heard from a lot of players is that they want it to have more interaction throughout the game than with just The Psychic.  The Disguised rework makes their trait apply to all team reveals through traits or events. Spy on a pirate who’s Disguised? Their team will be flipped! Census with a pirate who’s Disguised? It will report one higher, or lower, than the actual number of ghosts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9032228c5b227cb68d3c11f828d66ad61a76523e.png[/img]

The Disguised now adds a lot of uncertainty to your games, and it’s a very safe claim for any initial ghost players - but as with all traits, it can only appear once, so watch out for those counter-claims (and maybe use the power of your Interrogator, if you have one, to find the real one).

As part of the rework, we’ve also made it so The Disguised can appear independently of The Psychic - so for those of you whose strategies relied on the presence of The Disguised to confirm or de-confirm the presence of The Psychic, you might need to think of new ways to force your Psychic out of hiding!

[h2]‘Watch a Pirate’ - On-screen team reveal[/h2]
Following the introduction of Spectator Mode in the Traitorous Update, we’ve added a new feature for players who would like to make their pirate’s team (and secret objective in Scored Games, or trait in Trait Games) public. We’ve seen streamers using Spectator Mode to run fantastic multi-perspective streams, and by using Watch a Pirate they can choose to share their team publicly on their stream with their viewers, while keeping it secret from other spectators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e14ca42ef7d64c5cf26d7ea5d43197ccc119a382.png[/img]

To initiate the ‘Watch a Pirate’ feature, you can click on any pirate in the lobby or in-game and choose ‘Watch Pirate’ from the pop-up menu. This player will then receive a prompt on their device to approve or deny the request. At any time, you can stop watching a pirate using the close button next to the pirate’s information.

[h2]New Player Tutorial[/h2]
For players new to Paper Pirates, we’ve added a Tutorial Island to the Plot a Course options. The Tutorial offers a more guided, gentler introduction to Paper Pirates, with some in-depth explanations of the various mechanics as you play through the game. The Captain will appear on-screen, with animations, to explain to you what the rules are regarding playing in, voting, events, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8757b53a6b79eb5aeb8de8618e40a540c19cb36d.png[/img]

Additionally, if you are new to Paper Pirates, The Captain will introduce you to all the key features of the game, including The Captain’s Log and The Bounty Board. If you’re a Paper Pirates veteran, The Captain might pop up from time to time to tell you about a feature you already know about - but rest assured, he’s only trying to be helpful!

[h2]New ‘Choose a Pirate’ Screens[/h2]
Whenever you have to choose a pirate - either in voting or in an event - we’ve added a little bit of extra personality to the screen by including little avatars of each player’s pirate, plus their pirate colour in big chunky (harder to misclick!) buttons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/452d7e612e24d5a9f11e58dd00ccfb0dab1d428b.png[/img]

[h2]Improved In-Game Update Notes[/h2]
The Update Notes button from the title screen has had a facelift! The in-game update notes now cover the headline features of each update, with a short description, right in the client. It’s a little more fun and friendly than the notes that were there before! The full patch notes are always available on Steam for anyone who wants to dive into the full details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/4f3954ba30ec960c178eabf8f3ff8c3eea0f910c.png[/img]


[h2]A Few Other Things[/h2]
[list][*] We’ve made some general improvements to the Photo Booth, which now saves your snaps with correct transparency. That means if you want to take a pic of your pirate against the green screen background, you now get a nice crisp copy of your pirate on their own ready for you to use as you wish!
[*] If you have Remote Start enabled in the options, the pirate who has the option to start the game is now labelled in the lobby with the addition of a crown icon.
[*] We’ve added Steam Rich Presence, which shows what’s going on in your Steam Friends List while you’re playing Paper Pirates!
[*] A few additional tracks of music have been added to the game so listen out when planning a voyage or journeying to the Shop Ship!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] We lost our special Paper Pirates cursor icon temporarily, but it has now returned!
[/list]

notes.title: Wishful Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Trait: [b]The Wishful![/b][/h2]
After adding the Trait game mode in 3.0, we’ve had an outpouring of positive feedback, and it’s clear that everyone loves playing Paper Pirates with Traits! One of the most common requests we get is for more traits, so with 3.1 we’re introducing the first new Trait: [b]The Wishful[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5992f94069dc3996f1a02d916564bacf17635982.png[/img]

On days when The Wishful does not play in, they may wish for an event from a selection displayed on their device. Their power is limited, however, and The Wishful only has three wishes - so can only use their power three times during any voyage.  Whether they use their power for good to help the humans, or for evil to help the ghosts, The Wishful is sure to have a huge impact on any games where they appear!

[h2]New Event: [b]Stowaway’s Brawl[/b][/h2]
We’re retiring an older event that we don’t think fits the Paper Pirates ethos, so we’re saying goodbye to Shipwreck in normal gameplay (it’ll still appear in certain Daily Voyages though, so it’s not gone for good!). To replace Shipwreck, we’re introducing a new event: [b]Stowaway’s Brawl[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/734e0ec98ff2c894f6d674d11b02351feca49ebd.png[/img]

During a Stowaway’s Brawl, a random pirate is chosen to brawl with the stowaway. The two brawling pirates each choose from rock, paper or scissors; Rock beats scissors, paper beats rock, and scissors beats paper. If the defending pirate wins or there’s a draw, nothing happens, however, if the stowaway wins, the stowaway and the defending pirate swap ranks!

[h2]The Shop Ship: Gene Botley’s Map Shop[/h2]
Sam Sherbot has set sail and set up shop with Gene Botley! The pair are now the proud owners of the brand new Shop Ship, which houses Sam Sherbot’s Outfit Shop as before, and the all-new Map Shop run by Gene Botley.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/30adb36d92c028e50a1b159385c28a5896eb29e3.png[/img]

The Map Shop offers pirates an opportunity to buy maps for a small amount of PP Coins which show you how to reach a previously played Daily Voyage. The Daily Voyage locations are mysterious though, so each map can only be used once! Be sure to visit Gene’s Map Shop if there’s any Daily Voyages you particularly enjoy playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/da1e43e16913a07dea14aec232d393e6649751fa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/f42bcbe25adb0bf2f393f5ac3ab11fbc4642fbee.png[/img]

[h2]Nine New Daily Voyages[/h2]
To celebrate the opening of Gene Botley’s Map Shop, we’ve expanded the destinations you can visit on your daily voyages with nine brand new daily voyages! They’re entering the daily voyage rotation, so look out for them appearing when you check your daily voyage each day. Including new adventures where the crew can get stranded on a desert island, to being thrown overboard by a lethal assassin, there’s a whole new suite of configurations here offering a new take on Paper Pirates every day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/87f6eff882ce12bcb9beb88918995f278616c871.png[/img]

[h2]Save your Custom Game Configurations[/h2]
We love making custom games, and we know that you do too! To help streamline the process, we’ve added the functionality for you to save a predefined configuration to play again later. You can save up to fifty different game setups, and access these directly from the new Plot a Course menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/defcfba93d71865c5c23a1c39c4fa53215822ec8.png[/img]

[h2]Plot a Course Menu[/h2]
To help keep things fresh, we have a new menu screen for when you’re choosing to plot a course. Deciding between a Classic, Scored or Trait game has never been more fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/95a6c1814a8fd4b5f2767f756bb59d65b94501ff.png[/img]

Additionally, the Plot a Course screen lets you access your saved Custom Configurations or play any Maps you’ve bought from Gene Botley’s Map Shop!

[h2]Revamped ‘How to Play’ Guides[/h2]
We’ve overhauled the way the how to play information is presented from the game setup screens, to make it more informative and to help new players get into the game. Filled with video clips and guides to show the different elements of Paper Pirates, we hope the How to Play button for each game mode offers a quick and easy way to bring any new players up to speed on how to get started with Paper Pirates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/87c3d1346e6dd83e1a17a24360e8e48271170487.png[/img]

Additionally, we’ve made some improvements to the ‘How to Play’ button on the device. If you’ve got players who are new to the game, make sure to point them to the menu - there’s always a handy rule summary there if they need it!

[h2]In-game Chat Tooltips[/h2]
When you’re playing Paper Pirates on your device, we’ve given a few bits and pieces a lick of paint to make them look a bit spiffier. As part of the visual overhaul, we’ve also added tooltips to the in-game chat! Say the name of a secret objective in a Scored Game, or a Trait in a Trait Game, and it’ll create a tooltip link where you can immediately check out the details of that objective or trait, directly from the chat interface. Handy for all landlubbers new to the crew!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6fd869a6575162e013c08d31bb25b595fb5d5aa6.png[/img]

[h2]New Emotes[/h2]
The new in-game chat interface also comes with an added bonus: four new emotes! Your pirates have never been so expressive! The four new emotes include waving, laughing, confusion and most excitingly, a rank-based emote! That’s right, whether you’re the Captain, Stowaway, Cook, or any other rank, pressing the rank-specific emote button will have your pirate enact a little animation that’s unique to that rank! They’re super cute!

[h2]A Few Other Things[/h2]
[list]
[*] The ‘Default’ game mode is now referred to as the ‘Classic’ game mode throughout Paper Pirates
[*] We’ve made some improvements to the Day One experience for spectators, to decrease the likelihood of spectators having to wait until the host reaches day two to start spectating
[*] There’s a new “Copy” button in the Lobby, next to where the room code appears. Clicking the copy button copies a join URL to your clipboard, which you paste into any chat applications to share with your crew. If they click the link, they’ll be taken to the Paper Pirates joining website, with the room code already pre-filled (e.g. https://paperpirat.es/?room=TEST) to make joining your game even easier! What’s even better - you don’t need to reveal the room code to copy the URL to your clipboard, so if you’re streaming the game, you can share the link to join the game without even needing a room code hider!
[*] If you’ve got ‘Auto-hide Room Code’ turned on in your game options, entering a room code to spectate a game will now hide the room code as you enter it so you don’t reveal the room code to your audience when streaming
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The default number of innocent players in a customised trait game should now be a more rational number
[*] Bots sometimes failed to hide from the wasps in the Wasp Nest event, but should now always be ready to jump into a barrel!
[/list]

notes.title: Traitorous Update
notes.notes:
[b]New Game Mode: Trait Games![/b]
Our third game mode adds another new way to sail on the seven seas! Returning to the original team-based nature of Paper Pirates, the Trait game mode gives you a whole new way to help your team - whether you’re a human, or a ghost!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/cbd287ed5dcfbac4bc3c53b7a6cd23513a949836.png[/img]

[b]Traits[/b]
At the start of a Trait game, pirates are allocated a unique trait from the eleven traits available. These traits give each pirate a twist on the way they play the game - for example, The Assassin will always vote first in each round of voting, while The Pure cannot ever become a ghost, no matter who they vote for or what actions they take in events. Whether you choose to share your trait with the crew, keep it a secret, or maybe play more sneakily and weave a fishy tale to cover your tracks by lying about your trait, they’re sure to totally change the way that you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/b29ffff484c11e6443b98314a0e600866b5c0b11.png[/img]

You can learn about all of the Traits in the Captain’s Log, and when making a Trait in Custom Games you can also choose to include or exclude specific traits based on your own personal preferences!

[b]Innocents[/b]
In each game, a number of pirates may be allocated the Innocent Trait. These pirates have no special abilities, but are excellent scapegoats for mischief. If you’re not ready to disclose your Trait yet, or simply want to cause some trouble, you can always claim to be Innocent! In Custom Games, you can use the slider to set a minimum and maximum number of Innocent pirates, to personalise the game to your liking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/16111f8b43217740e3508bf207809b4b4dced256.png[/img]

[b]Game Spectating[/b]
We know that many of you play Paper Pirates remotely, with people who aren’t - or can’t - be with you in person. To help you play together, we’re introducing a spectator game mode. To spectate a game, enter the game’s room code after launching the spectator mode from the main menu while they’re still in the lobby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/87d317039a1833f64a6cbc4ba34d08d4980b9cec.png[/img]

To join the game as a pirate, you’ll still need to use the Paper Pirates website (https://paperpirat.es), but now the main screen will be replicated to anyone spectating through their own copy of the Steam game.

We hope that this enables more people to play Paper Pirates together where screen sharing facilities might otherwise be unavailable. Now, to play together, all you need is a copy of the game each and a room code!

[b]Community Bounties[/b]
Bounties have levelled up! With 3.0, we’re introducing Community Bounties to Paper Pirates. When a community bounty is active, you’ll see it right at the top of the title screen. These bounties have big goals, and must be completed within a limited time - but the good news is, anyone who plays Paper Pirates during the bounty contributes to the Community Bounty! If everyone completes the bounty before the time’s up, a limited-time reward - such as increased gold rewards - will become available to everyone playing games for the duration of the reward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/d7475a8691de48f6bb705ab66c6003f6e5fcf5c6.png[/img]

The first bounty starts RIGHT NOW, challenging everyone to complete 100 games within seven days. Reaching the goal will unlock a 1.5x coin multiplier to all coins earned for seven days after the bounty’s completion!

Please note that to participate in a Community Bounty, you must have the ‘Collect Anonymous Usage Data’ feature turned on in the Options menu, so that we know you’ve played a game!

[b]And what do the people at home think?[/b]
We’ve also added a new way to choose your events when playing in Custom Games! We’ve heard that pirates love when the audience participates, and some of you were always disappointed when each new day passed and the audience’s choice didn’t happen. So the new mode - Audience Choice - ensures that, when an event needs to happen, if you have an audience and they’ve picked events, it’ll always choose one of their choices!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c8b97fda9d94130fe4615c8b323040f8f1b356c2.png[/img]

If you select Audience Choice and you don’t have an audience, or they’re feeling a little sheepish about making choices, you’ll get random events as normal. Nothing ventured, nothing gained, as they say!

[b]A Few Other Things[/b]
[list]
[*] New regular bounties are available, asking you to play a number of Trait games, or games with the event selection method set to Audience Choice
[*] Three new achievements - and hats! - relating to Trait Games have been added for you to earn
[*] Trait Games statistics have been added to the Leaderboard
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Occasionally in Crossing the Gap, the person who fell from the vines could be haunted by their own ghost! Oops! That should no longer be possible, because who’d haunt themselves?!
[*] Coloured hats worn by pirates on the docks in Fishing for Treasure sometimes mysteriously looked as if they’d taken on brand new appearances, and didn’t match their true appearance. This should no longer be the case!
[*] The achievements ‘Treading Water’ and ‘Greedy for Gold’ were sometimes not correctly granted to players who had moved further from shore, or earned treasure, during their voyage.
[/list]

notes.title: Valentine Voyages - Valentine’s Day Event!
notes.notes:
[b]Find Romance on the seven seas with Valentine Voyages![/b]

This February, we’re celebrating with the sixth Paper Pirates Seasonal Celebration, Valentine Voyages! Running from 7th February - 21st February, celebrate the season of love with a festival of romance, and a whole host of seasonal goodies in Paper Pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/10863840e04dc67ddb538deb9a827c1b0b854ffa.png[/img]

[b]Limited Time Costumes[/b]
During Valentine Voyages, Sam Sherbot has some new outfit options available to unlock in the Outfit Shop! If you buy an outfit option during Valentine Voyages, you can wear it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ade404eb0ec6218c91afe44e536d3a89f03a6b58.png[/img]

The full list of outfit items available during Valentine Voyages is:
[list]
[*] Faces - Animal (Teddy)
[*] Top Hair - Cupid’s Curls
[*] Headwear - Pendant (Romantic)
[*] Hands - Animal (Teddy)
[*] Hands - Potted Plant
[*] Shirts - Animal (Teddy)
[*] Shirts - Sweater (Heart)
[*] Shirts - Tee (Heart)
[*] Belts - Quiver (Cupid’s)
[*] Legs - Animal (Teddy)
[*] Legs - Cupid’s Sash
[*] Feet - Animal (Teddy)
[*] Feet - Winged Sandals
[/list]

Additionally, during Valentine Voyages, pirates have access to two unique hats, available to everyone in voyages started during the event.  Once the event’s over, the hats will disappear from your collection until next year, so be sure to wear them while you can!

[b]The “Cupid’s Arrow” Event![/b]
Go on a sailing adventure during Valentine Voyages, and each day there is a chance you may encounter the “Cupid’s Arrow” event. A random member of the crew is given the opportunity to fire Cupid’s arrow at another. Whoever they fire it at will have their role changed to match the person who fired the arrow - whether they were human, or ghost! Keep track of the arrow, and see if you can deduce whose role is what as you forge ahead on your voyage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/3cae8ed3f5ff7093f24412ac2bfe9555dab9cd20.png[/img]

[b]Valentine Celebrations in the Photo Booth[/b]
To celebrate Valentine Voyages, there is a limited-time Foil available in the Photo Booth, in the Captain’s Log. Take the opportunity to snap your favourite pirate templates, and share any pics you take! 

Invite bots into your game during Valentine Voyages, and you may find some of the regular crew replaced with a super romantic guest, out to help you find love at sea! They’ll only join your games during Valentine Voyages, but this bot has their own personality and appearance for you to enjoy.

notes.title: Adventures Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=p-IpcZaeZ4I;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Adventure Events[/b]
Patch 2.8 brings with it a grand sense of adventure, as we introduce a new type of event to Paper Pirates! When an Adventure Event occurs during your journey, the crew temporarily takes a pitstop, engaging in a mini-adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/be35f1fe704f7521601e78eb2914935a3a1ccf4a.png[/img]

During an adventure, the crew have the chance to pick and choose which events take place, and multiple events will happen in quick succession. It’s an all new way to experience events - and the things that happen on an adventure don’t just stay on the adventure, they’re going to affect your game when you’re back on the ship too!

[b]The Island Adventure[/b]
The very first Adventure Event is the Island Adventure, where the crew explore an island they discover way out in the seven seas! Together you have enough resources to explore two regions of the island, so pick wisely which bits of the island you want to see each time you visit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ef67d95bfeb1064f2777d12811e43558ddb111f2.png[/img]

The island has nine regions in total, which means there are nine new fun-filled events for you to experience as part of the Island Adventure. From fishing off the docks to diving for treasure, whichever activities you try out on your trip to the island it’s sure to shake things up in your game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e807bffa018d9e1ad242a6fbc1fa605eda6e6659.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/22c8ffbdfd7bafd432a746c90c3bdfe39286b298.png[/img]

As an extra bonus, there are five new achievements relating to the island. Work hard when you’re on an adventure, and maybe you will discover a new hat for your efforts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c561ed0828e57b5a7cf3095981a69b6e91fb2a88.png[/img]

[b]Dress for Adventure in the Outfit Shop[/b]
Our resident shopkeeper, Sam Sherbot, is already well acquainted with the island, and has stocked up the Outfit Shop with a whole new range of island-themed goodies for you to browse and purchase using the coins earned for playing Paper Pirates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8539c269b39aed1263bab3393d5633b730e4be17.png[/img]

Continuing on the theme of dress-up, why not make an explorer outfit for your pirates - or go undercover and try to mingle with the local wildlife!

In total, there are over forty new outfit shop items, so there’s plenty of new ways for you to customise your pirates.

[b]New Outfit Customiser[/b]
As the number of things Sam Sherbot has on sale grows, we’ve overhauled the outfit customiser to make it more manageable when you have a large wardrobe for your pirates! The new outfit customiser is visible immediately when connecting to a game, and lets you start customising your pirate’s look right away. Don’t worry - the randomise buttons are still there for those of you who love to leave your look all up to chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/503c440b121bb28b9f7a4879ad43f605bab88ee9.png[/img]

Additionally, a new option on the outfit customiser lets you save your current outfit to a code, which you can then store and paste into the outfit customiser again to recreate your current look with one simple button press! This gives all pirates a great way to share dress-up tips, store a full range of outfits, or bring your outfit from one person’s game to another. If the owner of the game doesn’t have all the items in your outfit unlocked yet, they’ll get swapped out randomly for something they do have, so you might even uncover some new variations on your outfit that you love!

[b]Daily Sales at the Outfit Shop[/b]
Sam Sherbot has been feeling generous of late, so they’re going to start offering a daily sale in the outfit shop. Each day a few categories from the shop will have a select number of items on sale, sometimes for as much as 75% off! The sales are the same for everyone, so if you see an item that’s a total steal, don’t forget to let your friends know so they can visit the Outfit Shop and pick it up for their game too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/5796c5bdc0342950e0ed0cfd57edbf0a1f39f860.png[/img]

[b]A Few Other Things[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve revisited the Mutiny event to include crew interaction ensuring that the mutiny never feels like a product of bad luck. In the revamped Mutiny event, all players are given an opportunity to vote in secret as to whether they favour the mutiny, or not. If half or more of the crew vote to Mutiny, the captain is thrown overboard, with anyone who voted for the Mutiny having a chance to become a ghost if the captain was a human.
[*] We’ve improved the way events are chosen each day, so you should see events that you see less often appearing more, to help keep every game fresh and unique!
[*] The timer now has a visual indicator, which shows the number of seconds remaining before time’s up!
[*] The ‘Bandana’ outfit category has been renamed to ‘Headwear’ to more accurately reflect the type of items in this category.
[*] Attempting to start the game from a connected device now triggers a short countdown before the game is started. Attempts to start the game can be aborted from the main screen before the timer elapses.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] A rare bug which caused pirates to play-in twice is now hopefully resolved.
[*] Some text in the How to Play Guide for Default Games was accidentally duplicated, and has now been removed.
[/list]

notes.title: Ongoing Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Events That Go On and On[/h2]
We’re adding a new class of events to Paper Pirates, and reclassifying some of the old events to add clarity and readability to the game! ‘Ongoing Events’ are events which trigger some subtle rule or state change to the game, which lasts until something happens. You can see which ongoing events are currently in play by hovering over the ongoing event tabs in the top left of the main screen, or checking the ‘Ongoing Events’ pop-up from the menu on your device.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/97902111f3fc2d342a3a585f65863415085912d6.png[/img]

[h2]Six Brand New Events[/h2]
With ongoing events, we’ve not only reclassified some existing events, but we’re introducing six brand new events too! This brings the number of events in Paper Pirates - not including events only available through seasonal celebrations - up to [b]forty-two[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/acb94b0133a85682c33bae55e8c19a193e21cd76.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/11c3c32cd513ce7917831e2c1cef0f6d0e1258d9.png[/img]

Five of these are new ongoing events, and one of them is a regular event, but they’re all aimed at switching up the way you play! From Seeing Red, which prevents pirates from skipping their vote until someone is voted overboard, to Captain’s Fortune, which gives the captain three job choices at the start of each day instead of two until a job is successful, we’re sure these new events will mix up your games and add new strategies!

[h2]Ten New Achievements[/h2]
With new events, once again comes a bumper crop of new achievements - and as always, each new achievement comes with a new hat, which you can unlock as soon as you earn the achievement. If you want to be the most fashionable pirate on the seven seas, track down any of the ten new achievements as quickly as you can, and try out the new hats before the rest of yer crew!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/97c7b25881a2c4ecbec6a3fd914dd7ba9cf85d9a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/20aef87ebd1801fa6702b9169cb32de1d74496ca.png[/img]

[h2]Play Dress-up in Paper Pirates![/h2]
Sam Sherbot has been visiting many far off regions collecting the very best top pirate fashions from all over the world for sale in the Outfit Shop, all ready for you to play dress-up! They’ve brought back over 40 new items for you to spend your hard-earned pieces of eight on, many of which make perfectly coordinated outfit sets! Make sure that after playing a game or completing a bounty you check out the Outfit Shop to see what new things you can buy! If you’ve got one piece of a set, don’t forget to play more games so that you can get the other pieces - it would be a crime to miss out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ba488e757a1f434d646f0dbc96a5e99847baab8a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/90dc4117069bd4a1378b53d469bd5c22c88af46a.png[/img]

Don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm GMT on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/iterationgames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCqi1SJHkkB4a5h9Q-YJjLWQ]YouTube [/url]channel to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our Discord!

[list]

As the crew return from an adventure on a deserted treasure island, they race to see who has the honour of first footing the pirate ship. Those pirates who make it back first are granted good fortune for the coming voyage - and will be given a higher rank on the ship accordingly! Have your devices at the ready and press a button as soon as it appears, and any pirate has the chance of seizing the rank of captain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e831cfc8b0e177d7aea257fbb01c98d33741b69c.png[/img]

If you complete that one bounty over the course of the two-week celebration, you will receive a truly staggering number of coins in celebration and you’ll be well on the way to a prosperous 2021. It’s just too good to miss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/59bd49b447d6229954110902b701172d81a430c6.png[/img]

They’ll only join your games during Soggy Hogmanay, but these bots have their own personalities and appearances for you to enjoy.

notes.title: Bounties Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Complete Bounties to Earn Coins![/h2]
Bounties add a whole new way for you to earn coins for the Outfit Shop while playing Paper Pirates! Check the Bounty Board from the title screen, and you’ll see the bounties you currently have active. Complete bounties - such as Play 3 Scored Games - during your Paper Pirates adventures, and next time you check the bounty board, you’ll earn the listed coin reward! For every bounty you complete, you get another, so keep completing bounties, and you can really build your booty stores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/355d5e49c953ff7102e7bf28ff8b23a1a7cb4893.png[/img]

Got a bounty you don’t think you’ll complete? Once per day, you can remove a bounty from the board, and will immediately be offered a new one! There’s a huge range of different bounties, that will encourage you to play Paper Pirates in different ways. Happy coin hunting, pirates!

[h2]It’s the Captain’s Choice now![/h2]
When playing Custom Games, don’t forget that the Events tab lets you change how the events in your game are selected. We’re adding to the modes, by introducing “Captain’s Choice”, to complement Random events and Crew’s Choice events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6df5300a4572d89f981ba7f083e8cb6dba3b83d4.png[/img]

When playing with your event selection set to Captain’s Choice, each day an event would occur, the Captain is offered a choice of three events. Can you trust your Captain to share the event selection with the crew? Do you like the events they’re picking? With the Captain holding so much power over the ship, make sure you can trust them, and be ready to throw them overboard at the first sign of suspicion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6548e0ce0d6a84f340ca6bd0800b2b72b28fd074.png[/img]

If you’re playing with an audience, the Captain can decline to choose for the day, trusting in fate, and choosing the event the audience picked instead. The Captain doesn’t know what event the audience has picked before choosing it, so it’s a surprise even to them! Will the audience wildcard help or hinder the crew?

[h2]A Few Other Things[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pirates connecting to the lobby of a game that requires players to login with Twitch will now be shown a pop-up encouraging them to login with Twitch to play.
[*] The Outfit Shop interface has been given a minor facelift to make it easier to see which categories are sold out, and which have limited-time items left to purchase.
[*] Sam Sherbot has a small number of new items in stock in the Outfit Shop!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The ‘Found Stowaway’ event is now called ‘Found Stowaway’ throughout all the text in game
[*] Fixed a typographical error in the Wasp Nest event text
[/list]

[h2]Snowball Fight![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Yule Tides, and each day there is a chance it may begin to snow giving the crew the opportunity to partake in a little festive fun - a traditional snowball fight! When Snowball Fight is triggered, each member of the crew must choose who to pelt with a snowball. The pirate who receives the most snowballs will be thrown overboard! Who will you throw your snowball at? When they go overboard, if they’re a human, one of the people who threw the snowball will become a ghost… so choose wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7a1accfd0ad4a312a2e742cb941d8e0544603f6a.png[/img]

[h2]Naughty or Nice?[/h2]
During your Yule Tides sailing adventures, you may encounter the ‘Naughty or Nice’ event during the event phase of the game. In ‘Naughty or Nice’, one member of the crew must offer a gift to another. Question is - has the receiver been naughty, or nice? The present-giver must decide, with a host of fun positive outcomes for nice, and some meaner tricks for naughty. When the receiver is given the gift, they can choose whether to open it, or discard it. Do you think your crewmate has sent you something nice, or are they a ghost, hoping to catch you out? That’s all part of festive deception!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/ca1dc1444cf2c895d27eda046215a7b98511ab45.png[/img]

In the countdown to Christmas, the bounty board is celebrating each and every day that passes! Each day from the 1st-24th December, you’ll receive a special Advent Bounty, with a challenge for you to complete worth a bumper crop of coins! The advent bounties are time-limited, so you have to complete them on the day you get them - but don’t worry if you don’t, there’ll be a new one waiting for you tomorrow!

notes.title: 2.5.1 Bonus Update
notes.notes:
We’ve got a few little extra updates, features, and bug fixes ready for release a little earlier than usual - so we’re bringing them to you in the 2.5.1 Paper Pirates Bonus Update!

[h2]Twitch Integration[/h2]
At the request of the lovely streamers who have been playing Paper Pirates, we’ve added Twitch Integration to Paper Pirates. If you’d like to ensure that your players are using their Twitch usernames to join your games, enable ‘Require Twitch Login’ from the main menu options before starting your game! Players who aren’t logged in to Twitch will automatically join your audience instead (unless you have Audience Mode turned off, which case they won’t be able to join at all!).

To play with a connected Twitch account, click the Twitch logo in the top-left when connected via your device. Once you’re connected via Twitch, you won’t be able to change your name - so press the Twitch icon again to disconnect your account, and you’ll be able to change your pirate name again.

[h2]Kick Pirates from the Lobby/In-Game[/h2]
Another requested streamer feature is the ability to remove pirates from the lobby and from the game. Where previously you could click on a pirate to mute them, doing so now opens a menu, where you can choose whether to mute a pirate (preventing them from sending messages to the chat) or kick them from your game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e52d03ef5e9a1b86071624d89ebadec4c190b469.png[/img]

If you kick a pirate after your game has started, that pirate will be replaced by a bot, and they won’t be able to reconnect.  Please be very careful and be absolutely certain that you want to remove that pirate before kicking them!

[h2]Keyboard Menu Navigation, Accessibility Mode and Spoken Room Codes[/h2]
In our efforts to improve Paper Pirates accessibility, we’ve added a first pass at keyboard navigation to in-game menus, which you can try using the arrow keys.  

Additionally, we’ve introduced an Accessibility Mode, which can be turned on either through the main menu options or by pressing left shift three times. When Accessibility Mode is turned on, spoken prompts will announce which menu option is currently selected. This functionality initially covers the main menus and options screen, and there are some additional spoken prompts during the game to indicate key gameplay elements (e.g. how much treasure is remaining).

Finally, we have added a button to the lobby screen which allows for the room code to be read aloud. This button can also be accessed and selected via the aforementioned keyboard navigation.

The accessibility features are currently very much in testing, and we would greatly appreciate feedback on these via the Paper Pirates Discord, or through the Steam forums.

[h2]A Few Other Things[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now hover over each pirate’s objective in the round history to see a full description of their secret objective at the end of the game.
[*] If a pirate ends a Scored Game on the ghost team, the ghost haunting them will now join them on the party podiums to share in the celebrations.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hats in the ‘new hat unlock' toast were appearing behind the model’s head! Now they aren’t.
[*] If someone voted for you during a Shroud of Fog event, the little black spots appearing all over your device gave the game away as to who voted for you - oops! They’re now properly obscured by the fog. Spooky!
[*] When playing a game with event selection set to “Crew’s Choice”, some events were appearing a little too often.
[*] The ‘Lost at Sea’ Daily Voyage wasn’t correctly activating the Shroud of Fog event when it should’ve been.
[*] When playing with Crew’s Choice, rarely on days with no audience vote, an audience vote from a previous day could have accidentally been chosen.
[/list]

notes.title: Día de Muertos - Day of the Dead Event!
notes.notes:
[h1]Honour the Spirits of the Dead during Día de Muertos![/h1]
In the first week of November, we’re honouring the spirits of the dead with our second seasonal event, Día de Muertos! Running from 1st November - 7th November, celebrating for a whole week to give everyone the chance to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/6a9a4efaf227747203018a1cf05a2c6e46af761e.png[/img]

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]
During Día de Muertos, Sam Sherbot has some new outfit options available to unlock in the Outfit Shop! If you buy an outfit option during Día de Muertos, you can wear it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today! The full list of outfit items available during Día de Muertos is:
[list]
[*] Face - Calaveras (Cobwebs)
[*] Face - Calaveras (Flowers)
[*] Face - Calaveras (Horns)
[*] Face - Calaveras (Toreador)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/7d81d52a140c42ef5a5df42e4945958a2bafc0d0.png[/img]

Additionally, during Día de Muertos pirates will be able to wear a unique hat - La Calavera Catrina is available to everyone in voyages started during the event.  Once the event’s over, the hat will disappear from your collection until next year!

[h2]Honour the Spirits![/h2]
Go on a sailing adventure during Día de Muertos, and your crew will have the chance to honour the spirits of the departed. During the Event phase of the game, the Honour the Spirits event may activate for the duration of Día de Muertos, offering a randomly chosen pirate hidden information relating to how many ghosts have been successfully cleansed from your game so far…

[h2]A Special Spiritual Bot[/h2]
Invite bots into your game during the Día de Muertos, and you may find one of the regular crew replaced with a special La Catrina-themed bot! She’ll only join your games during the Día de Muertos event, but she has her very own personality and appearance for you to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/560551b733aff1fbb7ec7de3ebf3e695596cc2ba.png[/img]

notes.title: Victory Update
notes.notes:
As we prepare to say goodbye to the Haunted Seas event, we’re setting sail for destination 2.5! The focus of this patch is improving the Paper Pirates user experience, and hopefully making it so that everyone who plays can get a better understanding of the rules. Don’t be too sad about the end of Haunted Seas - keep an eye on the Steam updates for more seasonal events as they happen!

[h2]Celebrate the Winners with an All-New Game End Experience[/h2]
The game’s not over when you reach the shore or all your treasure’s gone overboard, and we’re recognising that with an all-new, freshly revamped game end experience! New screens and animations add tension as each crew member is revealed to be a human or ghost, and if you made it home safe? Watch out as the captain’s role is dramatically revealed, revealing the winning team to all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/cda33e5b70d65118482d26dbee61388240f1d798.png[/img]

If you’re playing a scored game, there’s a second game end screen featuring our party podiums, that show each pirate’s coin total. Watch out for a last-second reversal of fortune as the secret objectives are revealed - especially if you have a Demotivated Stowaway!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/a524d8bce54308d7c9599b673b7c6d09d537b71b.png[/img]

[h2]Pirate Leaderboard[/h2]
Every time you play a game of Paper Pirates from 2.5 onwards, your player statistics will be saved to your pirate template. Keep using the same pirate name to build up a score over time, and then see how you fare amongst your friends with the new Leaderboard! On the Leaderboard, you can sort by a number of stats (including human wins and ghost wins!) to see who’s truly the most victorious pirate of all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/c4bc5beb971b362038513b832ef36882e143feae.png[/img]

[h2]Player Chat Improvements[/h2]
We’ve given the in-game chat a little bit of a facelift, to make it more user friendly! The chat history has been separated from the Game Log (which you can still find in the menu), and shows up when you’re sending a message. Additionally, each player is assigned a colour which shows up throughout the game - in their nameplate, in the chat, and during the game end screens! There are ten colours in total, but don’t be fighting amongst yourselves for your favourite colour - they’re randomly chosen each game!

[h2]Connected Player Guidance and Graphical Improvements[/h2]
The connected player client has received a visual overhaul with 2.5, which adds improved guidance throughout the game indicating what you need to do and when. Additionally, there are a host of fun new animations that play at certain points in the game - look out for all the different event animations as you play! If you’d like to reduce your bandwidth usage while playing, or improve client performance, you can turn animations off in the menu after you’ve connected to a game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9fc426aa0ef66bd591c3422bf25cf09ed25aa385.png[/img]

[h2]The Captain Returns![/h2]
For this patch, we’ve coordinated some socially distanced voice recording, and we’re delighted to welcome back Captain Wilson who has topped up the voice acting in Paper Pirates. Once again you can look forward to announcements throughout the game, including the rules introduction, during events, and in the new improved game end screen!

[h2]Voting History[/h2]
During voting, your connected device will now display an indicator of who is currently voting (remember, pirates vote one by one from stowaway to captain!), and a record of who each pirate voted for - or a note to say they passed their vote if they did!

[h2]Scurvy[/h2]
Patch 2.5 sees the introduction of one new event, but it’s sure to really mix up your games! When treasure goes overboard, there’s a chance the Scurvy event might activate, offering a pirate a bowl of fruit. Share the fruit amongst the crew, saving pirates in turn - the question is, is there enough fruit to save everyone…?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/e3f6f348e48aa3f7a89afd2412e44678a5b709ec.png[/img]

Don’t forget that you can join us every Saturday at 8pm GMT (adjusted time for the UK’s daylight savings time!) on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/iterationgames]Twitch [/url]for our weekly dev stream, or pop by our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCqi1SJHkkB4a5h9Q-YJjLWQ]YouTube channel[/url] to see Let’s Plays of Paper Pirates, How To videos and more! Or if you’re looking for a crew to set sail with make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/f2hdFN6]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Haunted Seas - Halloween Event
notes.notes:

Throughout October, celebrate Paper Pirates’ first seasonal event by taking part in the Halloween-themed Haunted Seas event! Running from 1st October - 31st October, a whole host of spooky goings on are waiting for you.

[h2]Limited Time Costumes[/h2]
While the Haunted Seas event is on, Sam Sherbot has some new outfit options available to unlock in the Outfit Shop! If you buy an outfit option during Haunted Seas, you can wear it all year round - but the items will be disappearing from sale when the event is over, so don’t delay and buy today! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/9c93f2075acb1839b9c00e88f88d90e94160e5fd.png[/img]

The full list of outfit items available during Haunted Seas is:
[list]

[*] Top Hair - Widow’s Peak
[*] Accessories - Fangs

[h2]Trick or Treat?[/h2]

Will they take the easy option and choose a treat, or are they feeling brave and willing to risk a trick?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810747/8f43e2ec5efa27f908031cb7e1011a8f949bc46b.png[/img]

[h2]Halloween Bots[/h2]
